olivier batroc.name: Olivier Batroc
olivier batroc.origin: Olivier Batroc was a member of a group of French revolutionaries called the Cirque de la Revolution. Captain America, Bucky Barnes, and the Howling Commandos, on a mission in France after beating a group Nazis and taking their weapons and uniforms, encountered Olivier and the Cirque de la Revolution. Olivier and his compatriots told them to stop, and because of their uniforms attacked them, thinking they were enemies, with Olivier taking the charge attacking Captain America right away. Nick Fury revealed who he was and stopped the fight between both groups revealing his true identity and telling everyone that they were actually allies, and that The Gypsy (Marilyne) the group leader was his contact in France. When the Howling Commandos were devising a plan to attack Red Skull's base camp at the Eiffel Tower, Olivier told them the base camp was actually in the Louvre Museum according to his sources because Adolf Hitler was interested in the art at the museum. Fury wasn't believing the story but ended up going there because Captain America said they couldn't let the Nazis destroy the museum, since it was an important part of French culture. On arriving at the Louvre, they realized this was a setup and that Olivier had allied with Baron von Strucker with the intent of saving his group, who he considered family, by delivering the Americans to him. Strucker then betrays Olivier and tells him that the Americans would die that night but Olivier and his group would be sent to a concentration camp. Enraged, Olivier attacks Strucker, only to be shot in the chest by him. As he was dying, Olivier told Marilyne that he only did what he did to protect their family. He then asked her to take care of his grandson, and died in her arms.
powers: Olivier has no superhuman powers, but he is a master of savate, the French art of kickboxing.

olivier bedwette.name: Olivier Bedwette
olivier bedwette.origin: thumb|left|Sitting Bullseye's original look; circa 1976 Sitting Bullseye was a CIA operative who was sent to infiltrate the American Indian Movement to look for proof that they were producing illegal alcohol. The Natives eventually discovered his true identity and tattooed a large target on his chest before running him off of their reservation. The CIA let Sitting Bullseye go as he could no longer work undercover with such an identifying mark. He was one of the mediocre super-villains gathered by Dr. Angst to form the Band of the Bland. Angst had gathered them as part of a plot to assassinate then-presidential candidate Howard the Duck. Bullseye and the rest believed that the reason for this attack was to raise their own profile, but in actuality Angst had been hired by an outside party to murder Howard. Bullseye and the rest were also tricked into believing that their powers had been enhanced by a mystical element called Promethium, which was actually a placebo administered by Angst. The Band of the Bland confronted Howard at Doctor Strange's Sanctum Sanctorum where Howard was helped by the Defenders. The Defenders defeated the Band and they were presumably sent to prison. Years later, Bullseye was released from prison and had started a business where he ran a survival techniques training course for rich businessmen. Dr. Angst escaped from prison and approached Bullseye, as well as the rest of the Band, reorganizing them to carry out his latest plot. This scheme became known as the Cosmic Squish Principle and involved releasing a large amount of pocket universes into their own dimension, thereby destroying the universe as it currently was, and creating a new world which the Band of the Bland would be the masters of. The Band were defeated by a group consisting of Howard the Duck, the She-Hulk, Louise Mason, The Terror, the Critic and Brent Wilcox. Sitting Bullseye targeted the old and wheelchair-bound Laslo Pevely, not knowing that he was secretly the Terror, and chased him into a nearby jungle, where he instead took a savage beating from the Terror, who regained his superhuman powers just in time to defeat the Band.
abilities: Sitting Bullseye has been trained by the CIA and is therefore adept in hand-to-hand combat, techniques and in the use of conventional firearms. He is also very good with a bow and arrow.
weapons: Firearms of various types, knives, grenades. Previously used a bow and arrow with suction-cup tipped arrows as his weapon of choice.

olivier raven.name: Olivier Raven
olivier raven.origin: Olivier takes after his mother, Rogue, more than his father, having a quick temper and loving to fight. Ironically, he resembles his father (aside from the hair) as much as his sister, Bekka, resembles their mother. Unlike his mother though, he is more interested in martial arts than brawling, showing the same finesse and style in fighting as Remy and showing considerable skill given his age. It is clear that he has had training and practices often with his father. He also has shown to have his mother's powers of energy absorption, which led him to at some point permanently absorb the power of telepathy, which he hates.
abilities: Olivier was trained by his father from childhood.

ollerus.name: Ollerus
ollerus.origin: Ollerus the Unmerciful was a mighty military commander who sought to take Valhalla from Hela. He started to assemble an army which included two powerful sorcerers, Casiolena and Poppo the Cunning, and hid in a mountain shaped like a shark tooth in the hills of Valhalla. Once the Goddess of Death discovered about Ollerus' plan, she summoned Valkyrie, then with the Defenders in Midgard, to lead her own troops against the rebels. Poppo had a plan to recruit Valkyrie against Hela's forces, turning the tide of battle to Ollerus's favor. Amid a struggle between Hela and Ollerus' armies, the mountain moved; causing an earthquake that broke the battle up. Once Valkyrie discovered the origin of the shockwaves, she fell into a trap where Brunnhilde's body would be split from human host Barbara Norriss, who would then pose as Valkyrie. After locking Brunnhilde in a room, through the fake Valkyrie and his henchmen's magic, Ollerus was able to cast death upon many Midgardians, including Valkyrie's fellow Defenders Hulk, Nighthawk, and Hellcat. This created an army as large as Hela's. The new legions, specially due to the superpowered additions, gained the upper hand and even knocked out an escaped Valkyrie. However, once the Defenders realized the one that drafted them was actually Barbara Norriss, they defected to the underwhelmed Hela troops and gave an advantage. Witnessing this, Ollerus signaled to the mountain, which proceeded to move towards the battlefield; generating an earthquake. Hulk decided to smash the mountain, and upon the base's destruction, Ollerus was defeated. To ensure Ollerus' banishment to Niffleheim would not lead to further rebellion, Hela banished herself along, leaving Valhalla to Harokin.
powers: Like all Asgardians, Ollerus has , enough to beat Valkyrie in hand-to-hand combat. He also seems to enhance the powers of magic users.
abilities: Ollerus is a mighty military commander and who had no problem in convincing warriors to join his rebellion.

olnar.name: Olnar
olnar.origin: Olnar the First was the last of the wizard-kings to rule the Dark Dimension before the coming of Dormammu and Umar. A descendant (many times removed) of G'uran the Great and Oka'an, Olnar was one of the Mhuruuks, the multi-species group of wizards who were the governing elite in that realm. Olnar's reign began during a golden age of peace and security that had begun 28 "great" cycles (the equivalent of 28,000 Earth years) earlier thanks to the lasting peace arranged by Oka'an. However, while the other Mhuruuks (who were Olnar's advisors) regarded the time before Oka'an as days of chaos and misery, Olnar perceived that period as a time of ancient glories that he dreamed of resurrecting. Despite his dreams, the first 27 cycles of Olnar's reign remained peaceful. Near the end of the 28th cycle of his reign, two strangers named Dormammu and Umar came before Olnar's Azure Throne seeking sanctuary. The brother and sister claimed to be fugitives from the fabled dimension of the Faltine and offered to show Olnar new ways of power that would expand the boundaries of his realm. The other Mhuruuks distrusted the twins and they strongly warned Olnar against trusting the exiles but Olnar was intrigued by their offer since it fit with his dreams and he granted them high status in the realm. Dormammu and Umar then showed Olnar how to break down the barriers between worlds and taught him how to absorb those other universes into the Dark Dimension. However, while these conquests did expand the realm, they also revived the old and long-shunned war-like ideals, and that made Olnar increasingly unpopular among his own people. Midway through the 29th cycle of Olnar's reign, the cunning Faltinians "assisted" Olnar in annexing the neighboring pocket universe inhabited by the Mindless Ones, savage, tireless and indestructible creatures who attacked anything and everything they saw. Once released into the Dark Dimension, the Mindless Ones began to rampage across the realm, killing everyone they encountered, beginning with Olnar himself, as the Faltinian twins had planned all along. Dormammu and Umar used this invasion by the Mindless Ones as an excuse to exterminate most of the Mhuruuks. The twins then combined their magic to erect a great mystic barrier that confined the Mindless Ones within a pocket of the Dark Dimension. As the twins had anticipated, their victory over the Mindless Ones had won them the gratitude of the people and, since Olnar's son and heir was still an infant and thus too young to rule, the people chose them to become their regents. Dormammu then cast a spell of silence on the few surviving Mhuruuks and sent them to wander through the realm to be shunned as Outcasts. Since the twins considered Olnar's son Orini to be harmless to them, he was allowed to live and was raised as a ward of Dormammu, eventually becoming the Dreaded One's closest disciple. It was soon after he had assumed the countenance of manhood that Orini met Umar for the first time when she approached him one night and seduced him. However, Umar found her first brief sexual experience to be disgusting and she fled from Orini who did not see her again until six lesser-cycles later, after she had given birth to their daughter, Clea. Orini raised Clea alone and only he and Umar knew that Clea was Umar's daughter.
powers: Great mystical powers.

fields.notes: The history of Olnar that was presented in is very similar to that recorded in the chapters on the "Legends and Lore of the Dark Dimension" that were presented in - but there are some minor differences. This is primarily due to the fact that the first version was what was taught to young Dark Dimension natives in order to encourage them to worship the Faltinians and the latter was a more objective account from the Book of the Vishanti. Although the BotV account makes it clear that Dormammu and Umar were deliberately manipulating Olnar in order to usurp his rule of the Dark Dimension, it does not specifically state that they knowingly guided him into his fatal encounter with the Mindless Ones. One of those differences is that Orini is depicted as pink-skinned and white-haired in the first account but as blue-skinned and black-haired in the second. No explanation for this discrepancy has yet been provided.

omaka.name: Omaka
omaka.origin: Omaka led an unsuccessful coup on the Red King which was thwarted when she lost in battle to Caiera the Oldstrong. Years later, she briefly battled with Skaar before forming a mutual alliance in defeating a group of Wildebots. As they followed the trail of the Wildebots for the technological source of the Old Power, the came to the city of Okini which was a free city that was lead by the still-alive Red King who had become a cyborg. Princess Omaka refused to believe that the Red King could become a hero and fled the city to join forces with Axeman Bone taking her guardsman, Kram, with her. Omaka continued her alliance with Axeman Bone and was made Queen by a simulacrum of the Hulk, raised by Caiera's Old Power to take down Skaar. Her reign as Queen was short lived as Sakaar was destroyed and consumed by Galactus and she was forced to flee the planet in one of the Shadow Peoples Stone Ship's among the few other remaining survivors who came to be commanded by the Hulk's other son, Hiro-Kala. Omaka travelled with him to the planet of Giausar which also possessed the Old Power, Hiro-Kala's actions began to worry Omaka and she worked with others to try and take Hiro-Kala down before he could continue destabilising the planet and risk its destruction. She was then killed by Hiro-Kala when the peoples of Giausar attempted to return her to him as a show of good faith in their bargaining with him.

omar and his dummy.name: Omar and his Dummy
omar and his dummy.origin: Omar and his Dummy were petty thieves who were active in the 1940s. Omar had set up a ventriloquist act and his "Dummy" was really a midget in disguise. The pair became wildly popular, fooling audiences into thinking that Omar was a very talented ventriloquist. After one of their performances, the Dummy stole a necklace from a woman in the audience. Unfortunately for the pair they pulled this brazen theft on the night that Private Detective Mark Mason had taken the Blonde Phantom on a date to see their show. The Blonde Phantom spotted the Dummy sneaking backstage but lost him. Accusing Omar, the phony ventriloquist had an alibi when one of the stage hands vouched that he was back stage the whole time. Later, the Blonde Phantom overheard Omar talking to the Dummy about the theft and burst into his dressing room. Unaware of whom he was talking to, the Blonde Phantom was taken by surprise and knocked out by the Dummy and locked into a trunk to suffocate. Omar and the Dummy then took on a request to perform at a charity ball intending to rob it. However, the Blonde Phantom arrived and exposed their scheme, bringing the police to arrest them. The fate of Omar and his Dummy are unknown.

Unaware of whom he was talking to, the Blonde Phantom was taken by surprise and knocked out by the Dummy and locked into a trunk to suffocate. Omar and the Dummy then took on a request to perform at a charity ball intending to rob it. However, the Blonde Phantom arrived and exposed their scheme, bringing the police to arrest them. The fate of Omar and his Dummy are unknown.
equipment: The Dummy wore a disguise that made him look like a ventriloquists dummy.

He attempted to kill his colleague Maddie Baldwin to frame developers. Later his organization's compound was attacked by the Folding Circle who came to recruit Firewall into their group. He also tried to convince Namorita of the New Warriors to join his group.

omar karindu.name: Omar Karindu
omar karindu.origin: In 1933, the Star of Capistan was discovered in the ruins of Dashetal by an unnamed man who became possessed by the Star and was transformed into the Red Rajah. Omar Karindu shot the Rajah and took possession of the Star for the . Karindu was a close friend of Doctor Strange, and therefore approached the Sorcerer Supreme when the Cult could no longer control the Star. Strange, however, became mesmerized by the Star and was transformed into the Red Rajah, with all of Strange's powers at its command. When the Defenders came to Karindu searching for their teammate, he informed them that Strange had been transformed by the Star. Karindu eventually found himself under control of the Star as well, as its power increased. He was later freed from the control of the Star by the Defenders.
powers: It would appear that Karindu has some sort of mystical knowledge and ability. The exact nature and extent of which is unknown.

omar mosely.name: Omar Mosely
omar mosely.species: Human enhanced by an imperfect version of the Super-Soldier Serum
omar mosely.origin: Omar Mosely became the Black Marvel as part of the super-soldier program during World War II. It was originally intended that Dan Lyons would become the Black Marvel, but his father forbade it, and the opportunity was passed to Mosely. Along with the other volunteers, the Black Marvel formed the Six American Warriors. Realizing the racial views of the day would not allow for a black man to be accepted as a masked hero, Mosely led people to assume it was Lyons behind the mask, posing as his chauffeur. This belief was even held by his teammates, who would not find out the real identity of the Black Marvel for years. The Black Marvel embarked on many adventures with the American six. However, when they stumbled upon the Red Skull's doomsday plot, Captain America became trapped in a vortex along with the Skull. After the war ended, the remaining five warriors were ordered to disband, although Mosely vowed to find a way to free Cap. He studied for years but to no avail, and instead became a teacher. Years later, the Six American Warriors (bar Captain America) were reunited when the Kingpin tried to acquire the Doomsday device. Along with Spider-Man, they set out to stop him. Eventually, the Red Skull was released from the vortex along with Captain America. The Red Skull transformed his son into Electro, but the Six American Warriors and Spider-Man defeated him, although Cap became trapped in the vortex again. After, the other five, including Omar, went back into retirement.
powers: As a member of the Six American Warriors, the Black Marvel (as well as the Destroyer) came closest to duplicating Captain America's powers after receiving the super soldier serum.
weaknesses: Since their powers wore off after a while, the six (bar Captain America) rationed their powers with rings.

omega android.name: Omega (Android)
omega android.origin: Omega is a giant android created by the Inhuman, Maximus, to lead a rebellion of the Alpha Primitives. Maximus was able to harness all of the secret guilt of the Inhumans over the enslavement of the Alpha Primitives. Creating Omega with this power, he used Omega to lead an assault on the Inhumans, causing an open war in Great Refuge. Crystal and the visiting Fantastic Four discovered the nature of Omega and Maximus' plan, explaining it to the crowd. When the Inhumans realized that their own guilt was the source of Omega's strength, they dealt with their feelings of prejudice, and Omega lost his power, becoming immobile. As a result, Black Bolt (the leader of the Inhumans) enacted reforms so that all Inhumans would be treated equally. Later, during the wedding of Pietro Maximoff and Crystal Amaquelin, Ultron impersonated the android and attacked the Avengers and Fantastic Four just before they were about to attend the wedding, but Ultron-7 was defeated by the child, Franklin Richards, when his brain was activated by a psychic attack and struck back in retaliation.

omega thanosi.name: Omega (Thanosi)
omega thanosi.origin: Armour was among a series of clones Thanos created to test the capabilities of potential enemies or allies. After experiencing nihilistic and destructive qualities, Thanos considered the clones a failure and kept them in cold storage in one of his hideouts. After being freed from their containment's by a meteor, the clones decided to bring about the universe's end and believed that Adam Warlock was the key to this as he had made contact with Atlez, a cosmic being whose life kept the universe in existence, to find his successor. (This was actually a scheme concocted by Atlez to speed up Warlock's search for his successor.) While his fellow clones schemed against and fought various heroes and Thanos, Omega preferred to build up his power by feeding off planets like Galactus did. After sensing the awakening of Atlez's successor Atleza Langunn, Omega traveled to Earth to put an end to her. When Thanos teleported Atleza away to another planet, Omega chased them to that planet as well. Omega was then confronted by the various heroes that defeated his fellow clones. After destroying Omega's ship and Spider-Man blinding him with webbing, Thanos teleported everyone and himself back to Earth while he had a fleet of remotely-controlled ships fire upon Omega, killing Omega in a massive explosion.
powers: He was allegedly twice as powerful as Galactus.
abilities: but likely not as intelligent.
weaknesses: Omega couldn't speak and had slow reflexes.

omegatron.name: Omegatron
omegatron.origin: At one point during his fall through endless universes, Yandroth was empowered by a strange dimension. Yandroth returned to Earth to create the Omegatron, and engineered it so that upon Yandroth's death, Omegatron would detonate every nuclear stockpile on Earth. Omegatron was created through magic and science and thus could not properly be destroyed through one or the other alone. Omegatron housed a huge nuclear weapon capable of destroying virtually all life on Earth. It must however attain power for this device to utilize it, and it had to say the word "Yandroth" to activate it. After becoming aware of Omegatron's existence, the Defenders went to the lighthouse in Point Promontory where it was housed in. Before Omegatron could absorb enough energy to activate its apocalyptic program, Doctor Strange put a spell on it and stopped time around it. Strange also made the lighthouse appear inactive so no one would accidentally start Omegatron again. Some time later, Valkyrie and Namorita traced a disappeared Hulk and Namor to the lighthouse Omegatron was in. Omegatron revealed that the spell on him was weakened and created five Hulks and five Namors, and only one of each was real. While the heroes managed to discover the real ones, Omegatron absorbed enough vibrations to activate his doomsday weapon, and grew a giant body out of the machinery that contained his head. His control over Namor and Hulk was stopped and before he was able to speak Yandroth's name, Hulk knocked him over, and Valkyrie chopped off his head with the Ebony Blade, effectively destroying him.

omegex.name: Omegex
omegex.origin: Omegex was a powerful robotic construct created with a singular purpose: to destroy its designated target. After the Red Hulk struck Uatu, the Earth's Watcher, the resulting interference led Omegex to lock onto the Red Hulk's unique energy signature and begin its pursuit of him. Omegex normally destroyed entire planets by imploding their cores, but it determined that the Red Hulk was a singular species and therefore focused its efforts on eliminating him instead. Omegex confronted the Red Hulk at the Ross family farm and quickly demonstrated overwhelming strength, sending him flying from the barn before pursuing him to Boston. During their battle, Black Fog temporarily incapacitated the robot, allowing the Red Hulk to strike it across the city, but Omegex continued to overpower him. Even after General Fortean and his forces joined the battle, Omegex destroyed Fortean's rock soldiers and continued its pursuit of the Red Hulk. The Red Hulk eventually attempted to use his energy-absorption abilities against Omegex, but discovered that the robot's power was too great for him to handle. Zero/One subsequently used artificial bio-signals to deceive Omegex into believing that the Red Hulk was elsewhere, buying time to study Ross. Once the robot isolated Ross's true energy signature again, it resumed its pursuit and ultimately defeated him. However, when Ross reverted to his human form, Omegex interpreted the disappearance of the Red Hulk's energy signature as the completion of its mission and dissolved in a flash of light.

omir.name: Omir
omir.origin: Omir was the Snake-Charmer in Fritz Tiboldt's Circus in the 1940s. When the group was hired by the Nazi party to tour the United States and eliminate key military officials, Omir was loyal to the cause. He was instrumental in the murder of Commissioner Newsome, using his trained cobra to lethally bite the commissioner. Captain America and Bucky ultimately took down the circus following the murder of Newsome. Omir's subsequent fate remains unrevealed, however, as Fritz Tibolt would return to Germany and resume his circus, it is possible that Omir resumed working for Tibolt. As such, it is noteworthy to mention that Tibolt would later be murdered by Nazis who evaded capture in retribution for his failure, it is unknown if Omir had met the same fate.
abilities: Omir is an expert snake charmer
weapons: Omir has a poisonous cobra that obeys his musical commands.

omnivore.species: Alien suit of armor obtained by Iron Man on Battleworld that gained life after returning to earth
omnivore.first_appearance: Marvel Super Heroes Secret Wars Vol 1 8
omnivore.origin: On Battleworld, Reed Richards and James Rhodes used several alien materials for temporary modifications to the Iron Man Armor after the armor was damaged in battle. Upon his return to Earth, the parts seemed to be non-functional. Rhodes removed them, leaving them in snow bank in New York. The parts combined into a creature calling itself the Omnivore. It headed to the nearby Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. Facility seeking food. It destroyed and ate the security forces. Blue Shield's force field protected him from the creature, but he was effectively trapped in it to avoid the creature's fluid. Quasar arrived and confronted the Omnivore. He found quantum energy was ineffective against it. Thinking of a plan, he lured it into the project's magma tap. Once the heat became too much, he returned to the surface and closed the tap. It is unknown if the Omnivore was destroyed.
powers: Dissolving fluid which breaks almost anything down for it to consume. Growth and increased power as it absorbs. Able to repair itself, and command severed limbs.

omolola.name: Omolola
omolola.origin: When T'Challa first formulated his sleeper agent program, lovers Omolola and Jhai faked their own deaths in order to join. Despite swearing to absolute secrecy and celibacy as part of the program, however, Omolola and Jhai maintained a dangerous ongoing affair. When the pair met in Santiago, Chile, they were trapped in a "kill box" by Wakandan terrorists, and despite their best efforts at self-defense, Omolola was led to believe Jhai had been killed. She immediately contacted T'Challa to inform him of the attack, and the two visited his body in a nearby funeral home together. Though T'Challa ordered her to stay put, she followed him to Moscow on his mission to retrieve the rest of the agents, and he begrudgingly allowed her to join him. After visiting Russian, Belgium and German agents, Omolola and T'Challa came to Georgetown, Washington, D.C. to inform agent Kimura of the program's conclusion. Though they managed to protect Kimura and her family from another terrorist attack, they were again ambushed in Rock Creek National Park; emerging victorious from the battle, the surviving terrorists self-destructed, preventing them from being questioned. Omolola subsequently accompanied T'Challa to Arakko, though she did not know the purpose of this trip - contacting another sleeper agent, Nezhno. Following a direct attack on Princess Shuri's laboratory, T'Challa became suspicious of Omolola as the only surviving sleeper agent, and accused her of being the traitor. Though he threatened to kill her, he was interrupted by the arrival of Akili's Hatut Zeraze, led by Shuri, who had discovered fabricated evidence of her guilt. Omolola was instead arrested and taken before the Wakandan parliament; after some further research, however, it was determined T'Challa himself must be the traitor, and Omolola was released. Omolola joined Shuri in a secret lab in the savanna, assisting T'Challa by contacting the Dora Milaje. Omolola, Shuri and the Dora joined forces with Storm to beat back the rogue Hatut Zeraze threatening T'Challa's life. Omolola's life seemed to calm down for a time after this, and she was found in Milwaukee, Wisconsin when T'Challa had to deliver the difficult news that Jhai had only faked his death. She then joined T'Challa and Wakandan politician Imani on a direct attack on Jhai's base. When T'Challa ultimately could not bring himself to kill his childhood friend, Omolola stepped in to quickly and painless decapitate the terrorist leader, and then presented the head to her former king. After a life of violence and secrecy, Omolola found it difficult to think of herself as anything but an assassin. With T'Challa banished from Wakanda, Prime Minister Folasade sought Omolola out, suggesting that she use her skills as part of a new Wakandan black ops unit.
abilities: Elite Wakandan Training: The sleeper agents were personally trained as warriors by King T'Challa.

once upon a time.name: Once-Upon-a-Time
once upon a time.origin: Once-Upon-A-Time was an elderly sentient clock that was the product of Jimmy Jupiter's imagination coming to life in the realm known as Nowhere. Once-Upon-A-Time was the oldest being who lived in the Valley of Time, the personification of all time on Earth. A respected member of his community, he carried a book that was a record of all the realm's happiest memories. He was briefly seen by Jimmy when the boy was being guided by the Valley of Time.

one magician.name: One (Magician)
one magician.species: Powerful sorcerer trapped inside the Staff of One
one magician.origin: Long ago, the One was a powerful warlord sorcerer with an army of thralls to do his bidding and act as blood sacrifices to fuel his magic. Two to three hundred years ago, the One lost a battle to Tokiko Minoru and her thrall army. After his defeat, Tokiko offered him a choice: "die by her sword or live as her sword." Using her magic, Tokiko transformed the One into the Staff of One, twisting and binding his magic to serve her and her female descendants. However, the One was powerful enough to insist on some terms of this own. One boon granted to the One was granting him a few hours to plead his case and win his freedom every time Mars aligns with the Earth and the Sun. The Staff of One was passed down through the female descendants of the Minorus. Eventually, Tina Minoru received the Staff of One from Judy Minoru, who gave her the traditional speech about the rules and conditions of using the Staff. During her time with the Staff of One, Tina Minoru would escort the temporarily freed One to a pancake house in Anaheim followed by a long walk on the Santa Monica State Beach before returning him to the Staff. The celestial alignment to temporarily free the One had only occurred twice since Nico Minoru took the Staff of One from her mother. During the first, which took place shortly after the Second Superhuman Civil War, Nico slept through his entire visit; however, the One created a flesh and blood limb to replace the arm Nico had lost battling Apex in Murder World. During the second, Nico nearly freed the One, but instead renegotiated their contract; now, rather than exchanging blood for magic, every spell would allow one drop of the One into Nico, allowing him to hear the outside world and have a small voice within her.
powers: The One is an immensely powerful sorcerer. He is the source of the magic inside the Staff of One. His magic appears to require a sacrifice to work, but even without a sacrifice or apparent incantation, the One is capable of: Levitation

one above all celestial.name: One Above All (Celestial)
one above all celestial.origin: ===Celestial War=== Predating the Multiverse by many times over, the One Above All was one of the Celestials from the First Cosmos, the first-ever universe. They rebelled against their creator, the First Firmament, and the Aspirants, shattering the First Cosmos into the Second Cosmos, the first-ever Multiverse. This began the multiversal cycles. The Celestials created and/or appointed many beings to serve them, including but not limited to the Exterminators, Cal-Horra, and the Omegas. Each time the Multiverse ended, the Celestials passed on to the next incarnation of the Multiverse. At some point, the Celestials also began to assign Kings in Black. Although split across the Multiverse, the Celestials' counterparts are interconnected aspects of themselves and not separate beings. Thus, the One Above All of Earth-616 is one aspect of the true One Above All. ===Commanding the Fourth Host=== thumb|left At the conclusion of Arishem the Judge's 50 year judgment of Earth, the planet's Fourth Host arrived to determine if it should live or die. As the other Celestials descended on to the Earth, the One Above All commanded the Host from the mothership. Two American astronauts, three Deviants, and the Eternal known as the Forgotten One attempted to visit him; the One Above All scanned their minds and teleported the crews of each ship to a different spacecraft, allowing the Forgotten One to disarm the Deviants' bomb. The One Above All rescued the Forgotten One and then dispatched him to Olympia to advise all Eternals and gods not to interfere in Celestial judgment. The One Above All later teleported the Thunder God Thor and the Forgotten One aboard the mothership, and showed Thor an image of Odin bowing before Arishem from the Third Host. The One Above All then teleported Thor back to Earth. In the end, Arishem declared Earth as worthy and all the Celestials left. ===Secret Wars II=== When the Beyonder was about to kill Death, many cosmic entities, including the One Above All of the Celestials, gathered to protest. Death was killed, but the Beyonder was convinced to bring her back. ===Infinity Gauntlet=== thumb|right|With other cosmic entities After Thanos completed the Infinity Gauntlet, many cosmic entities gathered to make a request to the Living Tribunal to intervene. The One Above All and Ziran the Tester were the Celestial representatives. The Living Tribunal, however, decided not to interfere and the rest of the cosmic entities joined forces to take on Thanos head-on. Despite their united efforts, the cosmic entities were no match for might of the Infinity Gauntlet and were defeated. Thanos' carelessness allowed Nebula to steal the Gauntlet from him, which freed the cosmic entities from Thanos' prison. They immediately went on a full assault against Nebula, but were once again defeated by the Infinity Gauntlet. They were restored once Adam Warlock obtained the Gauntlet. ===Eternity War=== Most of the Celestials were destroyed when the Beyonders attacked the Multiverse. The Beyonders were trying to end the Multiverse, and succeeded, until it was brought back as the Eighth Cosmos. A few Celestials, including the One Above All, apparently survived. thumb|left|Rebirth of the Celestials Under the influence of the Celestials' ancient foes, the First Firmament and the Aspirants, the corrupted Lord Chaos and Master Order fused with the In-Betweener to become Logos and install themselves as the new embodiment of multiversal law. Logos then annihilated the remaining Celestials, while the First Firmament watched and laughed. However, the Queen of Nevers whisked the One Above All to safety within the Land of Couldn't-Be-Shouldn't-Be. During the final fight against the First Firmament's forces, the Never Queen used the One Above All to kickstart the rebirth of the Celestials, who then entered the Superflow and wiped out the Aspirants. With the corrupting agents neutralized, Eternity was able to summon the Ultimate Ultimates and defeat the First Firmament. ===Multiverse=== The Celestials exist across the Multiverse simultaneously. A Celestial's alternate reality selves are actually aspects of the same being. Despite this, their alternate aspects may have very different histories from the ones in the mainstream Marvel Universe. ====Earth-9997==== thumb|none On Earth-9997, this aspect of the One Above All was one of the Celestials who long since evolved past physical bodies. The Celestials reproduced by impregnating a planet with their essence, which in time would gestate into an infant Celestial. To protect the growing fetus, they would genetically modify the people of said world, greatly enhancing their evolutionary potential and imbuing them with a certain level of aggressiveness. One of these impregnated planets was Earth. After the populace of Earth fully mutated prematurely, the One Above All and other Celestials travelled to the world to purge it of all life before they could threaten the infant Celestial. They were met

one below all.name: One Below All
one below all.species: Dark aspect of the One Above All born from being corrupted by the Mother of Horrors
one below all.origin: {{Quote|What is the Hulk? What have you become? With these hands I build. With other hands, I break. I break to build anew. Have you my strength? Have you an arm like mine? Would you build, or break? You are my creation. I made you the counterweight. To ask of you. Are you ? And what of ? What of mercy? What will you become? For the left hand is strength. But the right hand is mercy.|The One Above All|Immortal Hulk Vol 1 50}} ===Origins=== A malevolent entity that resides in the Below-Place - the deepest layer of Hell, the One Below All is an aspect of the One Above All that serves as the One Above All's dark counterpart. When the Mother of Horrors, a being that wasn't created by the One Above All, desecrated Earth, He became angry and confronted Her with a spear made of His own Light. When He split the Earth in half in order to see what was going on, She took this opening to pierce His skin and infected Him with Her corruption, marking the first time He manifested as the One Below All. In a rage, the One Below All burned and murdered the Mother of Horrors' children, ranging from gods, demons, elementals, and titans. When He turned to the Mother of Horrors, He let out a roar so terrible it ripped the fabric of creation apart, creating a void where He dragged the Mother of Horrors into and subjected Her to unspeakable pain and suffering. While She couldn't die, the Mother of Horrors begged the One Below All to kill Her, but the One Below All denied Her this request as He knew that if He consumed Her She would corrupt His entire being. Instead, the One Below All crafted a mighty unbreakable chain from the First Firmament and a door so heavy it cannot be open except by Him. Thus, He chained Her at the depths of the void and left the corpses of Her children surrounding Her prison as a warning to those who would dare free Her. With His terrible work complete, the One Below All receded and returned to becoming the One Above All, shameful of the corruption within Him. Since then, the One Below All served a role to counterweight the ever expanding life in the Multiverse. Thus, the One Below All is the source of all gamma energy, infusing it with a third supernatural aspect and being thereby capable of using gamma mutates as avatars to manifest. As the One Below All is the other face or dark side of the One Above All, the One Below All has existed retroactively before any version of the multiverse or even existence itself, and is purportedly the source of all other evil entities. As the dark alter-ego of the One Above All, the One Below All is a creature without a mind of its own, possessing only terrible desires, destroying all so that the One Above All can begin the cycle of creation anew. In spite of this purpose, the One Below All still harbors its own goals, comparable to a 'Hulk' itself. The One Below All genuinely does hate and fear the Mystery, and it's ultimate goal is to destroy everything in the Multiverse and to become the one remaining presence in it, leaving no stories and no life left to ever exist. In spite of the One Below All's goals, it remained without a personality, incapable of acting beyond its role as a counterbalance. To do more, it required a host personality. ===Tammuz, the First Hulk=== In the year 9500 BCE, a young tribal villager named Tammuz sought to leave his people behind along with his friend Shalim. However, the village's elder and Shalim's father, Adad, discovered their conspiracy. Captured, Tammuz was then exposed to a gamma-irradiated meteorite, the "Good Green Eye", in order to be sacrificed to their "goddess" and make their tribe bountiful again. Adad kicked him into the crater, the meteorite absorbing him into it. That night, he was turned into the first Hulk, so the tribe ambushed and killed him without knowing who he was at first. Upon laying eyes on Shalim, he felt betrayed. Tammuz's soul went to the Below-Place, where the One Below All greeted him. As the Lovecraftian entity declared its purpose, Tammuz decided to embrace it. Upon being revived, his body reassembled by leaving the other villagers' insides, disfiguring them. As Shalim was the only one who did not ate his remains, he was not affected by this; he pledged for mercy, but Tammuz simply killed him out of his feeling of betrayal. Many millennia later, Tammuz would go by the name of Enkidu, seeking to die in battle to free himself from the One Below All. He learned of a "child god", deciding to battle it. He didn't realize, however, it was Eldest, the first-born of the Mother of Horrors. During their confrontation, as a skinwalker, she managed to possess his body. About to free the Mother of Horrors, the One Below All himself appeared before them and incinerated them. She left Enkidu's body to avoid the green flame, but Enkidu brutally subdued her and allowed them both to die at the hands of the One Below All, preventing Mother Vinruviel to be free. ===Immortal Hulk=== During his research into the properties of g

She left Enkidu's body to avoid the green flame, but Enkidu brutally subdued her and allowed them both to die at the hands of the One Below All, preventing Mother Vinruviel to be free. ===Immortal Hulk=== During his research into the properties of g
fields.personality: Being a manifestation of the One Above All, the One Below All doesn't possess a mind of its own, only the desire to become the sole remaining presence in the Multiverse. Serving as the counterweight of the One Above All, who is the supreme manifestation of love and good, it is the ultimate personification of hatred and every form of evil there is, making it the most maleficent entity in existence. Its power depends on hate, and its ultimate goal is to destroy everything in existence; as per its own nature, it cannot truly create anything, only destroy and corrupt. However, it's role is fundamental to the evolution of the Multiverse, so the One Above All can recreate it, even more complex than before. This aspect, however, didn't originally exist. It is the byproduct of the Mother of Horrors corrupting the One Above All, being also a manifestation of anything that viled the Multiverse.
abilities: Beyond any known system of abilities. He can also .
fields.notes: When Doctor Strange requested Mephisto remove the One Below All from the Hulk after a brief Defenders team-up, the Hell-Lord remarked that he was unable to do so because it was "far stronger than" he. Bruce Banner theorized that the symbiote god Knull, similar to Tanaraq, was merely an aspect of the One Below All or a creature it somehow controls. Knull is himself seemingly inspired in a few ways by the Cthulhu Mythos. Doctor Strange's theory in gives support to Bruce's; speculating that the essence of Anti-All, a creature born from the Below-Place and possibly tied with the One Below All, scattered across the Multiverse after being shattered by the Lifebringer One gave rise to other dark entities in the next Multiverses, including Knull. While there have been many beings that embody destruction and entropy, the One Below All is fundamentally different as it embodies un-making things and intentionally destroying them. It is not a natural part of the multiverse but outside of everything and a dark reflection of existence. It is the action of willfully and intentionally bringing destruction. This is referenced in with the description of the destroyer deity Angra Mainyu who could perform good works but chooses not to and freely chooses evil and destruction instead. The One Below All cannot create or make anything as creation is against its fundamental nature. It and its power are only capable of altering or destroying. No matter what intentions or desires a being using its power (in the form of Gamma Radiation) it can ultimately never be used for anything good or beneficial. This has been indirectly proven from all the horrors created by Gamma power over history and confirmed in with Tammuz realizing, after becoming a gamma mutate and resurrecting, that the One Below All's power is not meant for building. Puck has theorized that of all the demons claiming to be Satan he has encountered, the One Below All may be "the definite article".
fields.species: Dark aspect of the One Above All born from being corrupted by the Mother of Horrors

one feather.name: One-Feather
one feather.first_appearance: Peter Porker, The Spectacular Spider-Ham Vol 1 3
one feather.origin: Warrior One-Feather was one of the only two surviving members of the Duckowee Native American tribe, along with Chief Sitting Duck. As of the 1840s, they found a small town, Pleasantville, where they wanted to settle - but, before they could do so, Pleasantville was evacuated because the locals moved to California looking for gold. Sitting Duck performed spells so that time would not pass there and that noone could find them, giving rise to the legend of Shang-Goo-La. The spell failed during the 1950s and the town was assaulted by a band of barbarian bikers, the Sickle Club, who imprisoned the Duckowees. It took them 30 years to dig a escape tunnel; when they did, One-Feather was sent with a map to find help. Unfortunately, One-Feather's use of magic was imperfect and he turned into a baby, then an egg. Fortunately, One-Feather's map ended up in newspaper editor J. Jonah Jackal, who decided to go after the story. Although Shang-Goo-La was saved, Sitting Duck never knew what happened to his last brave one, One-Feather.

oneg.name: Oneg
oneg.origin: ===Celestial War=== Predating the Multiverse by many times over, Oneg was one of the Celestials from the First Cosmos, the first-ever universe. They rebelled against their creator, the First Firmament, and the Aspirants, shattering the First Cosmos into the Second Cosmos, the first-ever Multiverse. This began the multiversal cycles. The Celestials created and/or appointed many beings to serve them, including but not limited to the Exterminators, Cal-Horra, and the Omegas. Each time the Multiverse ended, the Celestials passed on to the next incarnation of the Multiverse. At some point, the Celestials also began to assign Kings in Black. Although split across the Multiverse, the Celestials' counterparts are interconnected aspects of themselves and not separate beings. Thus, the Oneg of Earth-616 is one aspect of the true Oneg. ===Earth-616=== A Celestial that apparently specializes in probing. During the Celestial's First Host on Earth, Oneg engineered the X-Gene in early humans. ===Multiverse=== The Celestials exist across the Multiverse simultaneously. A Celestial's alternate reality selves are actually aspects of the same being. Despite this, their alternate aspects may have very different histories from the ones in the mainstream Marvel Universe. ====Earth-9997==== Oneg the Prober is a member of the Celestial race. Having long since evolved past physical bodies, the Celestials reproduced by impregnating a planet with their essence, which in time would gestate into an infant Celestial. To protect the growing fetus, they would genetically modify the people of said world, greatly enhancing their evolutionary potential and imbuing them with a certain level of aggressiveness. One of these impregnated planets was Earth. After the populace of Earth fully mutated prematurely, Oneg and other Celestials travelled to the world to purge it of all life before they could threaten the infant Celestial. They were met with opposition from Black Bolt on the Moon, Oneg and the Celestials would kill Black Bolt and then set their sights on Earth. On Earth, they would be opposed by Namor and an army of sea creatures, Tony Stark in a giant robotic factor and an army of Iron Men robots, and an army of Asgardians led by Loki. This bought the Earth precious moments for the arrival of "Galactus" (actually Franklin Richards) who was called to Earth by Black Bolt before his death. Galactus was able to fight off the Celestials, and Oneg was one of the Celestials felled in the battle.
powers: thumb|right Presumably that of Celestials. Oneg casually blocked an energy blast from the Destroyer with the power of almost the entire Asgardian race.

oninay.name: Oninay
oninay.origin: Firemane is a Kymellian sorcerer; one of the few members of the Kymellian race who has learned to master his powers. He is a member of the Force Four and has been trained as a warrior from young age. The young heroes Power Pack met him and the other Force Four members when they visited Kymellia II to attend the funeral for the Smartship Friday (who later turned out to be fine though). They had been ordered to hang around with the human children during their stay at Kymellia II. At first, the Force Four acted friendly towards the kids, showing them around Kymellia II and, along with Byrel Whitemane, taught them more about Kymellian history. Later however, it turned out Power Pack had been set up by the Kymellian technocrat to face the Force Four in combat, under the guise of a training session. Despite their opponents only being children, Force Four did not hold back and attacked the team with all their strength. However, after an initial defeat, Power Pack was able to turn the tide on them and eventually defeated the Force Four, much to the dismay of the technocrat. Afterwards, the team sought out Power Pack to congratulate them on their victory and apologize for the fighting, stating they had no idea Power Pack was being tricked.
powers: Firemane was capable of and flame generation.

onomi whitemane.origin: Onomi Whitemane was queen of the White Room Kymellians, evolved from their natural state through Antigenesis. Her people made up one-fourth of the Universal Inhumans, who responded to Earth's moon in search of the Midnight King of prophecy, Black Bolt. Once Black Bolt returned, she became one of his five queens. When Thanos invaded Earth, resulting in Black Bolt in destroying the Inhuman city of Attilan, Onomi and the other Universal Inhumans chose to leave Earth and find a new place to live. They eventually established the city of Novahala as their new home on the continent of Akuunos on the planet Centauri-IV. Akkunos became their last resort because none of the species that compose the Universal Inhumans were accepted back in their respective homeworlds. When the Kree Imperium began ordering all surviving Inhumans to join it or perish, the Universal Inhumans arranged a secret meeting on an unnamed planet to discuss the situation. Before the Inhuman Royal Family arrived, Onomi and the other queens were considering surrendering to the Kree. However, the Kree arrived, including the Kree's new Inhuman soldier, Vox. Vox killed the queens, including Onomi, and their attendants, to send a message to Black Bolt that he wasn't safe.

oog martian.name: Oog (Martian)
oog martian.origin: Oog was a member of an alien race that called themselves Martians and lived on the planet Mars. Oog was their leader and warlord and was bold enough to call himself "Master of the Universe". Their race did not have the capability for interplanetary flight but observed and plotted to invade the planet Earth. They got their wish in 1949 when earthen scientist Professor Kulto invented a device that was able to pull the planet Mars closer to Earth, close enough for Oog to lead an invasion fleet to Earth. Oog led an invasion of Earth, causing massive destruction and death, as the Earth’s leaders scrambled to try and fight off the invasion. Also involved in the battle were Captain America and Golden Girl. Captain America attempted to board Oog's ship but was knocked out by a gas gun. When he revived, Oog demanded that Captain America bring him to the leaders of the world and demand their surrender. Instead, Cap brought Oog back to Professor Kluto's lab where he tricked the alien into believing that Kluto's device was a communicator. Cap then used the device to send Mars back to its original location. Oog then attacked, but was felled by a single punch that also destroyed Kluto's device as well and apparently killed Oog. The remaining Martians on Earth soon realized their world was out of reach, and facing starvation they opted to retreat to die among the stars.
weapons: Oog carried a ray gun rife and a pistol that emitted a short acting knock out gas.
weaknesses: Like all members of his race Oog could not eat or metabolize food that came from Earth.

fields.notes: Oog's claims that they were Martians are questionable at best considering the number of alien creatures who have claimed to come from the red planet. Perhaps they were even exiled to Mars, explaining their inability to build ships capable of at least interplanetary travel. However, all these points are speculative at best.

ookla.name: Ookla
ookla.first_appearance: Marvel Apes: Prime Eight Special Vol 1 1
ookla.origin: Ookla was an occasional companion of Iron Mandrill, the simian counterpart of Tony Stark on Earth-95019, a reality inhabited by anthropomorphic apes. At one point, Ookla was with Tony when he suddenly awoke from a disturbing dream that seemed more like a prophetic vision than a nightmare. Startled by his abrupt awakening, she asked if anything was wrong. Rather than explain, Tony quickly got dressed and prepared to leave, claiming that business required his immediate attention. With a mixture of amusement and resignation, Ookla told him that she would be waiting for him and urged him not to stay away too long. Tony privately reflected that one of the unexpected benefits of the collapse of the United Soviet Simian Republics was meeting women such as Ookla, who always introduced themselves by name, sparing him the trouble of remembering it.

fields.history: Oola Udonta was queen of the Incentaurians, evolved from the Centaurians through Isogenesis. Her people made up one-fourth of the Universal Inhumans, who responded to Earth's Moon in search of the Midnight King of prophecy, Black Bolt. Once Black Bolt returned, she became one of his five queens. When Thanos invaded Earth, resulting in Black Bolt in destroying the Inhuman city of Attilan, Oola and the other Universal Inhumans chose to leave Earth and find a new place to live. They eventually established the city of Novahala as their new home on the continent of Akuunos on the planet Centauri-IV. Akkunos became their last resort because none of the species that composed the Universal Inhumans were accepted back in their respective homeworlds. When the Kree Imperium began ordering all surviving Inhumans to join it or perish, the Universal Inhumans arranged a secret meeting on an unnamed planet to discuss the situation. Before the Inhuman Royal Family arrived, Oola and the other queens were considering surrendering to the Kree. However, the Kree arrived, including the Kree's new Inhuman soldier, Vox. Vox killed the queens, including Oola, and their attendants, to send a message to Black Bolt that he wasn't safe.

ootah negative zone.name: Ootah (Negative Zone)
ootah negative zone.species: Artificial Intelligence evolved into a Genius Loci
ootah negative zone.origin: Ootah was a large, artificial, self-sustaining structure on the surface of a planet in the Negative Zone. Ootah was created by a race of unnamed people that once inhabited Ootah's inner structure. These people gave Ootah a sense of self-preservation. Ootah then expelled these people from its structure like germs in the human body by creating a panic that caused the people to flee from their homes within Ootah. These evicted people were sealed off from Ootah and lived in the portion of the planet unoccupied by Ootah, as the massive construct continued to grow. Having lost most of their recorded history and technological advancement over the next four generations, the primitivized race discovered that those who approached Ootah would be destroyed by a laser cannon. Not understanding what they were seeing, they took this to mean that they needed to make sacrifices to Ootah, and regularly selected brides to carry out this task. However, they developed (or were granted) a prophecy that four strangers from the sky would some day come to their world and allow them to regain control of Ootah. Their prophecy was filled by the Fantastic Four during one of their explorations of the Negative Zone. Although Mister Fantastic was incapacitated by a paralyzing drug, the rest of the Fantastic Four convinced the Children of Ootah that they were there to help. With their leader down for the duration, the Invisible Girl, Human Torch and Thing stopped the next sacrifice. Seeing Ootah as a threat, they smashed their way into the citadel and destroyed the living computer brain within. The local tribe also stormed in and began ravaging the complex. Mister Fantastic revived too late to warn his team that they had just murdered a newly budding sentient life form, as Ootah had gained self-awareness and rejected the people who lived inside as a means of self preservation.
weapons: Armed with laser cannons of unknown origin that were lethal to organic life.

opal luna saturnyne.name: Opal Luna Saturnyne
opal luna saturnyne.species: Human. Opal was chosen to be the current Omniversal Majestrix at an unrevealed time.
opal luna saturnyne.origin: ===Early Life=== Saturnyne originally hailed from Earth-9, one in a myriad of alternative universes. She hailed from her world's version of Britain, but beyond that not much is revealed about her early life. When swearing, she referenced the Zoroastrian deity Mithras, implying this religion was dominant on her world. ===Omniversal Majestrix=== thumb|left As a highly intelligent and ambitious woman she ended up on Otherworld as the Omniversal Majestrix, a function where she was part of the Dimensional Development Court, oversaw the Captain Britain Corps and was charged with the safekeeping of the entire Omniverse. She only had to report to Merlyn, the Omniversal Guardian. In order to preserve the Omniverse, Saturnyne had no moral problems with sacrificing anybody, even an entire universe. Whenever she decided to take a more personal interest in a matter, she could call upon the Avant Guard, her personal elite. The Avant Guard appeared to be normal men, dressed in business suits and each carrying an umbrella, but these umbrellas were in fact highly advanced weapons, capable of various abilities such as inter-dimensional travel, destructive blasts and rays capable of devolving opponents. She was assisted by Dimples, an overweight man who loved Saturnyne deeply. Saturnyne herself cared little for Dimples and saw him only as a useful servant. ===Captain Britain=== Saturnyne first came into contact with Captain Britain, a warrior from Earth-616, when they met on Earth-238, also known as the Crooked World. This Earth was deemed to be a threat to the Omniverse and Saturnyne convinced Captain Britain to help evolve the backwards planet, hoping to eliminate its threat. They were opposed by the Status Crew, a group charged with maintaining the status quo. Saturnyne and Captain Britain cooperated and managed to evolve the world, but were surprised to see a bigger threat take its place: that reality's Mad Jim Jaspers used his powers to create the Jaspers' Warp, causing widespread insanity and the collapse of reality. Captain Britain and Saturnyne wanted to stop him, but were prevented by the Fury, a killer machine. Saturnyne fled with her Avant Guard, leaving a heartbroken Dimples and Captain Britain behind. Dimples was killed by the Fury seconds later. ===Jaspers Warp=== The Dimensional Development Court was not pleased with what they perceived as Saturnyne's failure. She was arrested and replaced by a man called Mandragon, who destroyed the Earth-238 universe to prevent the Jaspers Warp from spreading. Merlyn had saved Captain Britain though and the Fury managed to survive and escape under his own power. Captain Britain and the inter-dimensional mercenaries known as the Special Executive helped Saturnyne escape from the Court to Earth-616. On Earth-616, Mad Jim Jaspers, an even more powerful version than the one on Earth-238, came into power and threatened the world. Meanwhile the Fury also made its way to Earth-616 and came to battle with Jaspers. During the conflict, Merlyn seemingly died (though later he would reveal that he had just faked his death). In the end the Fury killed Jaspers and was killed shortly afterwards by Captain Britain and Captain UK from Earth-238 with help from Saturnyne and the Special Executive. Saturnyne managed to obtain cell samples of Jaspers though and threatened to unleash a clone on Mandragon's world if he didn't return her former position to her. Merlyn's daughter Roma succeeded her father. ===Excalibur=== thumb|right Despite having cooperated with Captain Britain at various times, her duty would come first and she came into conflict with Captain Britain when she sent the bounty-hunters known as the Technet after Rachel Summers. The Technet failed to capture her and Phoenix joined Captain Britain, Shadowcat, Meggan, and Nightcrawler to form Excalibur. Later events would reveal that Saturnyne was acting under Roma's orders at this time and that the Technet was meant to fail, resulting in the formation of Excalibur. She along with the rest of the Corps attended Captain Britain's wedding to Meggan. ===Abraxas=== Saturnyne was also summoned by Roma when the being Abraxas tried to destroy all creation. While Roma was killed, Saturnyne used some sort of power to protect Franklin and Valeria Richards. ===Mastermind=== Saturnyne remained Roma's servant and Omniversal Majestrix for several years until the villain Mastermind decimated the Captain Britain Corps and imprisoned Roma. Captain Britain managed to defeat Mastermind and Roma named Captain Britain, now more powerful than ever before, the new ruler of Otherworld. Saturnyne returned as Omniversal Majestrix, but had a bitter relationship with Brian, whom she deemed unworthy of his new position. ===Return of Mad Jim Jaspers=== Mad Jim Jaspers returned and threatened the Citadel and the Corps. She used a powerful energy weapon to disintegrate him but he was able to pull his molecules back together. He was about to kill her but the Exiles arr

opal vetiver.name: Opal Vetiver
opal vetiver.origin: Opal Vetiver was a bioengineer who spent most of her years working for the best agrochemical and biotech companies in the world. After realizing that these companies only used their knowledge to create seedless plants that could no longer reproduce in order to sell more products in the name of wealth and consumerism, Opal decided to form with some of her colleagues a group of like-minded agrochemicists, bio-technologists, and bio-engineers who specialized in genetic manipulation and the spread of all things botanical called the Hordeculture, who aimed within ten years to control the entire food supply of the world. She was part of an incursion of the Hordeculture to the Krakoan Harvest Center, located in the Savage Land. After a confrontation with Cyclops, White Queen, and Sebastian Shaw, they managed to collect samples of the Krakoan genome in order to study it and learn how it worked to convince the living island to support the aims of the Hordeculture or otherwise bend it to their will. Later, Vetiver was also involved in the Hordeculture's raid on the island of Genosha, within the framework of the Cotati invasion, where they tried to collect samples for study of the alien species. In the process, they fought plants and mutant zombies.
powers: By unknown means she acquired telepathic immunity. Opal Vevtiver has been alive 200yrs as a agricultural, biochemical and eugenicist expert like all her fellow experts at Hordeculture.
weapons: A lance capable of shooting gases and other substances of plant origin that have been shown to have the property to inhibit mutant powers. . It can also spray pheromones that generate illusions and other effects on males.

opul lun sat yr nin.name: Opul Lun Sat-Yr-Nin
opul lun sat yr nin.origin: Originally from Earth-794, Opul Lun Sat-Yr-Nin was a dictator who ruled her world with her lover, Kaptain Briton. Opul later met Briton's counterpart, Earth-616's Captain Britain, when he was mistaken for Briton and transported to Earth-839. Briton, who had been transported to Earth-616, was killed by Britain's sister, Elizabeth Braddock, when he attempted to rape her. When the mercenary group Technet killed her troops, Sat-Yr-9 went mad and started slaughtering her subjects, leading to her being overthrown and imprisoned when Roma sent Captain UK on a mission to capture her. thumb|left|325px Escaping to Earth-616 through a dimension gateway that had accidentally been opened by an unassuming civilian on Earth-616, Sat-Yr-9 killed her alternate reality counterpart, a businesswoman named Courtney Ross, and took her place. Coincidentally, Ross was Captain Britain's ex-girlfriend. As Ross, she tried to create a rift between Captain Britain and his current girlfriend Meggan Puceanu. Sat-Yr-9 also knew about Jamie Braddock's reality warping powers before anyone else including himself did (since she knew about the reality warping powers of Jamie's alternate reality counterpart) and arranged things so that Jamie's powers would be unlocked, at the expense of driving him insane. Courtney had intended to use Jamie and his great powers as a living weapon against difficult adversaries. Courtney used Jamie's powers to change her right-hand man, Nigel Frobisher, into a duplicate of the London crime lord, the Vixen, while changing Vixen herself into a fox. With Frobisher as Vixen, Sat-Yr-9 took over the Vixen's crime syndicate. With her power base built, Courtney attacked Excalibur, revealing her true identity to them. Sat-Yr-9 tried to enslave Captain Britain, against Frobisher's advice. Frobisher rebelled and was killed by Sat-Yr-9. Excalibur managed to defeat Jamie and Sat-Yr-9 and her troops were forced to flee. Captain Britain swore to avenge Courtney's death, but was unable to track Sat-Yr-9 down. She briefly joined the Hellfire Club as its White Queen, with Viper, a former HYDRA assassin, as her self-proclaimed "White Princess" and bodyguard. She has been seen publicly appearing as Courtney Ross again, trying to convince Captain Britain that she somehow is the real Courtney Ross. fields.history: Originally from Earth-794, Opul Lun Sat-Yr-Nin was a dictator who ruled her world with her lover, Kaptain Briton. Opul later met Briton's counterpart, Earth-616's Captain Britain, when he was mistaken for Briton and transported to Earth-839. Briton, who had been transported to Earth-616, was killed by Britain's sister, Elizabeth Braddock, when he attempted to rape her. When the mercenary group Technet killed her troops, Sat-Yr-9 went mad and started slaughtering her subjects, leading to her being overthrown and imprisoned when Roma sent Captain UK on a mission to capture her. thumb|left|325px Escaping to Earth-616 through a dimension gateway that had accidentally been opened by an unassuming civilian on Earth-616, Sat-Yr-9 killed her alternate reality counterpart, a businesswoman named Courtney Ross, and took her place. Coincidentally, Ross was Captain Britain's ex-girlfriend. As Ross, she tried to create a rift between Captain Britain and his current girlfriend Meggan Puceanu. Sat-Yr-9 also knew about Jamie Braddock's reality warping powers before anyone else including himself did (since she knew about the reality warping powers of Jamie's alternate reality counterpart) and arranged things so that Jamie's powers would be unlocked, at the expense of driving him insane. Courtney had intended to use Jamie and his great powers as a living weapon against difficult adversaries. Courtney used Jamie's powers to change her right-hand man, Nigel Frobisher, into a duplicate of the London crime lord, the Vixen, while changing Vixen herself into a fox. With Frobisher as Vixen, Sat-Yr-9 took over the Vixen's crime syndicate. With her power base built, Courtney attacked Excalibur, revealing her true identity to them. Sat-Yr-9 tried to enslave Captain Britain, against Frobisher's advice. Frobisher rebelled and was killed by Sat-Yr-9. Excalibur managed to defeat Jamie and Sat-Yr-9 and her troops were forced to flee. Captain Britain swore to avenge Courtney's death, but was unable to track Sat-Yr-9 down. She briefly joined the Hellfire Club as its White Queen, with Viper, a former HYDRA assassin, as her self-proclaimed "White Princess" and bodyguard. So far Captain Britain remains unconvinced, but hasn't moved against her.

Her other alternate reality counterparts are Princess Sa'tneen, Princess Anjulie, Queen Satyr-Nun, and the Queen Mother. Sat-Yr-9 can be distinguished visually from her alternate reality counterparts by a tattoo of her stylized knife emblem on her right thigh.

oracle phantom of the planetarium.name: Oracle (Phantom of the Planetarium)
oracle phantom of the planetarium.origin: The man who called himself the Oracle worked at the New York Planetarium in the 1940s. By 1947, he decided that he was going to rob the pay-telescope that was being used to collect money for charity. To this end he devised a convoluted plot in which he abandoned Astronomy for the prophetic portents of Astrology, and quit his job. He then returned to the planetarium to rant about fortunes of doom, making everyone around believe that he went mad. In reality, he was using this as a cover so that when his hired men stole the charity money he could assist them and not implicate himself. However, on the day of their big heist was also the day of a field trip from the Lee School was attending the planetarium. Among the visitors were school teacher Jeff Mace and his student Fred Davis Jr. (who were secretly Captain America and Bucky). When the thugs attempted to steal the charity money, two changed into Captain America and Bucky and fought them, but they managed to flee to another room with the stolen loot. The thugs were assisted by the Oracle who helped them hide it in a meteor display, unaware they were observed by Miss Todd the teacher in charge of the field trip. When Captain America and Bucky entered the room and found only the Oracle, they were about to dismiss him when Miss Todd outed him. Another fight broke out and while Cap and Bucky were busy with the Oracle's goons, the Oracle tried to flee with the loot. However, Captain America was able to knock out the Oracle with his shield and turn him over to the authorities. His subsequent fate is unknown.

oracle of ancient knowledge.name: Oracle of Ancient Knowledge
oracle of ancient knowledge.origin: The Oracle of Ancient Knowledge was a robot from a long-dead, forgotten civilization in an alternate timeline, having been designed and constructed to store vast amounts of informations. It also had defensive capacities in the form of short-range electric attacks. Arriving to Earth-616 very long ago by means unrevealed, the Oracle came to be worshipped by a monastic order on the planet H'aarg, who valued its immeasurable knowledge and insight, and considered it to be one of the oldest beings in the universe. The Oracle was kept in a Monastery, giving periodic audiences to its monks. In its appearances, the Oracle was typically robed and hooded and, as it was an android, its robotic nature was not evident. Still, the Oracle had to be connected to a power source via wires. To ensure the Oracle's safety, the fanatic monks had arranged a security system around it, including a protective planetary shield that required intruders to use baffler-equipped starships to enter the planet undetected. a huge robotic guard that had purportedly never been overpowered, and the monks themselves were willing to fight to death for their Oracle. Apparently there were no stardocks or starflight facilities on H'aarg, possibly to avoid visitors except those who joined the order so as to never leave. The Oracle began to develop delusions of godhood due to this. Thanos learned of the Oracle when he was seeking knowledge to protect Death from the Walker and coveted the Oracle's information. Deciding he had neither the time nor the interest to bypass the defenses on H'aarg himself, he instead recruited a team for that purpose: Geatar, whom he resurrected or cloned as well as Nitro, Rhino, the Super-Skrull, and the Titanium Man as his "secret defenders" (He discarded Annihilus, , Juggernaut, Ultron, Deathbird and Venom, after consideration). To convince them to accept such a quest of stealing the Oracle Thanos lied claiming that the order had riches that they could keep, as well as scientific knowledge that would tempt the Titanium Man, and that the Oracle was preparing for an inter-galactic holy war that would affect negatively both Thanos' interests and those of the Skrull Empire. Thanos convinced Geatar by accepting not to go after Nebula, whom Geatar loved. Planning on betraying the defenders once they had overcame the Oracle's defenses, Thanos gave them a baffler-equipped ship to reach the planet undetected, but he had sabotaged the vehicle so that it would explode shortly after arrival. The defenders indeed reached H'raag and burst onto the Monastery by breaking a wall (and killing one of the monks, Kamrik under the debrigs), but another monk immediately notified a higher authority. Immediately the monks attacked the intruders, making use of superior numbers and sacrificing their lives. The defenders managed to reach the Oracle's sanctum, where they defeated the guardian robot (thou the robot managed to injure Nitro). When they found the Oracle and Geatar tried to grab him, they found out the Oracle was a robot, to their surprise. The Oracle used its electric attacks to severely injure Nitro, but Rhino broke the wires connecting it to the power source, while Geatar threatened it with a gun. Once they had succeeded in their mission, Thanos safely teleported into the Sanctum, admitted he had lied to the defenders, and explained how they were stranded. After saying his goodbye, Thanos teleported away with the Oracle. Although abandoned by Thanos, the defenders then resourcefully escaped H'raag. Thanos used his advanced machinery to extract the Oracle's knowledge, and he thus learned of Tyrant, a rogue creation of Galactus, which led him to recruit Terrax and Ganymede to assault Tyrant, and in that fight obtain one of the power Tyrant's works, from which he gained extraordinary knowledge. The Oracle's fate after its encounter with Thanos is yet to be revealed.
powers: It was designed as a storage of vast amounts of information presumably meaning that it had immense knowledge. As an offensive capability, it has short-range electric attacks.
weaknesses: It needs to be connected to a power source via wires.

oranah.name: Oranah
oranah.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Oranah was a demon, a "being of darkness and shadow" that lived on Earth long eons ago, before the Age of Man, when the elder races roamed the world, Oranah was feared before all but the mightiest god-things. ===Hyborian Age=== During the Hyborian Age, circa 10,000 BC, it was known as the Stag and the Stag God, and was worshiped by the Stag Cult, who remained a minor worship in Brythunia, and was tolerated by the authorities. Eventually, a man known as the Stagbringer came to the Lema Plains and spread the worship of Oranah, professing that by bringing Oranah back on Earth, its worshipers would be free from their works, their masters and Earth itself. In order to summon him, they started by sacrificing hundreds of human and animal victims in ceremonies. Then they had to spread blood and fire upon their fields and villages, setting aflame their houses and butchering their own cattle and children. In response, Lady Alophic assembled an army (whom Conan and his hound Dread joined) in order to suppress the cult. As the two armies clashed on the field, the Stagbringer managed to summon Oranah at the moment Conan slew him. The army managed to defeat the Stag by encircling it with fire which consumed it. His name was invoked in the chant to activate the Crystal of the Elder Ones, and presumably (as "Oranoh) in a chant of a Kordafa shaman to the god Koh-Rom.

fields.notes: Oranah was created in "Feast of the Stag" ( ; February, 1988), written by Chuck Dixon and penciled by Gary Kwapisz. "Oranoh" was a word in the chant of a Kordafa shaman in the story Valley Beyond the Stars ( ; September, 1988), also written by Chuck Dixon, and is presumably an alternative spelling to Oranah. It is unknown if Oranah is one of the Elder Ones, but both Valley Beyond the Stars (Savage Sword of Conan #152) and Call of the Howling Shadows ( ; June, 1989), both written by Chuck Dixon, also involved the Elder Ones. Oranah's name was also part of the incantation to activate the Crystal of the Elder Ones in Savage Sword of Conan #161.

orann.name: Orann
orann.origin: Orann was a powerful mystic and one of the leading members of the Sorcerers Guild. Some time in the middle ages, a colleague of his Ebrok magically evolved cats into the Cat People. When Orann and the Guild learned what he had done they was disgusted by his actions and banished his creation to another realm. Ebrok's original two creations, Flavius and Helene escaped the purge by devising a magical glamour to hide as humans. When Orann found out he killed Ebrok. He tried to take them out but the retaliated by throwing a potion at him, which sends him fleeing out into town where he inadvertently spreads a new disease the "Black Plague".
