otto strucker.name: Otto Strucker
otto strucker.origin: Otto Strucker was a member of the mutant Strucker family. His father was Andreas von Strucker, who along with his sister Andrea were the international criminals known as Fenris during the 1950s and '60s. Otto, who inherited his father's mutant abilities, recognized the dangerous potential of his family and their powers. He made it his life's work to find a way to permanently suppress the X-Gene, a goal that led him to work for Trask Industries for 30 years until the company closed down. The only successful test subject Otto's work produced was his son Reed Strucker, who remained unaware of his own and his family's mutant abilities until he was well into adulthood. Otto's bitter personality caused him to become estranged from his wife Ellen and Reed. Despite having not spoken to his son for almost 20 years, the Sentinel Services questioned Otto after his grandchildren Andy and Lauren Strucker were exposed as mutants when Andy's powers manifested and destroyed a school. Not long afterwards, Reed came to Otto's antiques shop with John Proudstar, a member of the Mutant Underground, to speak with him about his work with Trask after the Underground discovered was still active and working with the Sentinels. Otto told Reed about his mutant heritage and his work in suppressing the X-Gene, but unfortunately knew nothing of Trask's recent work with the Sentinels. Sentinel Services agents searching for Reed surrounded Otto's shop. Leading them was Dr. Roderick Campbell, the scientist who revived Trask Industries using Otto's research to discover a way to enhance the X-Gene rather than suppress it. Otto volunteered to deal with the Sentinels when John realized they could not fight their way out of the shop. Otto said his goodbyes to his son, and asked him to tell his family what he told him about his past and to protect the world from Lauren and Andy's powers. Otto tried to throw the Sentinels off Reed's scent, but Dr. Campbell insisted his agents search the shop for any fugitives. Otto activated his mutant powers to defend his son, stunning Dr. Campbell and the Sentinels who brought with them a Hound, Pulse, who could shut down any other mutant's abilities. One of the Sentinels shot Otto in the chest to stop him, but Otto unleashed his powers on the Sentinels in his dying moments.
powers: Otto, like his father Andreas could generate plasma-based concussive blasts.

otto van shorn.name: Otto Van Shorn
otto van shorn.origin: Elderly, wheelchair-bound Vincent Kruger is left with a dilemma when his butler, Jeeves, becomes the latest in a long line of servants to storm off the property, due to fears of a locked room Kruger keeps in his home. While worrying about having to find another servant, Kruger is startled to when to find a mysterious man in his home. The man, balding with a heavily scarred face, introduces himself as Hauntly, and announces himself as Kruger's new servant. Confused, Kruger agrees, and the both of them turn in for the night. In the following days and weeks, Kruger grows more and more unhappy with Hauntly's presence, and his knowledge of Kruger's secret room. One morning, Hauntly informs Kruger that he has cancelled Kruger's newspaper delivery, broken his radio, and cut the telephone lines, cutting Kruger off from the outside world. Hauntly then reveals himself to actually be Kruger's former research partner Dr. Otto van Shorn. Van Shorn demands to know the secrets of Kruger's room, but Kruger refuses to tell him. Unrelented, van Shorn wheels Kruger out to the cliff behind his home and threatens to roll him over the edge. Kruger gives in, and directs van Shorn to the room. Giving van Shorn the key to the room, Kruger watches as he rushes inside to see his treasures, only to find an unseen horror. However, van Shorn forgets to remove the key from the lock, and Kruger slams the door behind him, locking van Shorn inside. As van Shorn pounds on the door, screaming in terror, Kruger thinks back to the last time he saw van Shorn. He recalls that some 30 years prior, he and van Shorn created a serum in their lab, dubbed Formula-X, that they believed was the key to eternal life. Kruger rushed into town to purchase small animals to test the formula on. However, van Shorn could not wait, and decided to forcibly test the formula on Kruger's wife and children, who were residing upstairs. When Kruger returned, van Shorn had vanished, and he dicovered that Formula-X did not grant eternal life, but instead disrupted the natural growth and functuion of body cells. After the screams stop, Kruger then breaks the fourth wall and asks the audience if they really want to know what's in the room. He relents and opens the door to reveal the monsterous, fanged shadows of his wife and children.

otto von bismarck.name: Otto von Bismarck
otto von bismarck.origin: In 1862, Otto von Bismarck became minister-president of Prussia and set about unifying Germany. He defeated Denmark in 1864, Austria in 1866, and formed the North German Confederation. Ottt Lyza Strang convinced Dracula to kill her husband Archibald Strang, who was vying for the position of Germany's President Minister. However, after he completed his task, she betrayed him so that Otto von Bismarck could claim the position itself and she could gain power and status through their secret affair. Dracula got revenge on her after Otto exiled her from Germany, turning her into a vampire. By Dracula's account she was killed later that year by Abraham van Helsing. He then waged a final war against France in 1870-1871, which allowed him to pronounce Prussia's king Wilhelm I as Emperor of the Second German Reich on January 18, 1871. After Wilhelm I's passing, his son Wilhelm II quickly dismissed Bismarck.

otto von doom.name: Otto von Doom
otto von doom.species: After his castle was attacked by heroes who tried to free the Fantastick Four, his face was heavily scarred, driving him more insane than before.
otto von doom.origin: A friend of Sir Richard Reed, Otto Von Doom, called the Handsome, was the ruler of Latveria. Doom's father engaged in breeding studies, which were condemned as heretical by some, such as the Grand Inquisitor. These studies yielded humanoid creatures that served Doom. When the Four from the Fantastik came to his country, he captured them and imprisoned them. He would often go to the dungeon to speak with Sir Reed of scientific ideas (most often he wanted to speak of explosives, poisons and machines) and use what he learned for his own purposes. He sent three assassins to England; one to kill Sir Nicholas Fury, one to kill Virginia Dare, and one, his ambassador, to kill Queen Elizabeth I. Though the first two were unsuccessful, the mechanized gift he'd sent the Queen succeeded in killing her. He also had some of his men follow Matthew Murdoch and Natalia Romanova to the Old Man of the Templars (Donal) that he might take the Templars' secret treasure for himself. Doom had paid Natasha and she betrayed Murdoch and brought him, the Old Man and the treasure to Doom's castle. Doom studied the treasure, a strange golden sphere that the Old Man had been carrying. But not knowing that it was not the real treasure, but instead a bomb. When Doom's castle was attacked by a boatload of heroes led by Nicholas Fury and Carlos Javier, Doom engaged them in battle. During this, the Four from the Fantastik were freed from their prisons and confronted Doom. Doom raised the golden sphere to the sky and it was struck by lighting in an attempt to unleash its powers, but it did not release the power Doom craved. Instead, he was nearly killed and horribly disfigured when the sphere exploded in front of him. When Natasha found him, he asked her to hide his face. Sometime after this, Doom had heard about the Four Who Are Frightful's story of traveling to a lost mystical city "over the end of the world" and hoped that he would find a way to restore his damaged face from the city's inhabitants. He hired the group to lead the journey. Wanting someone to document the voyage Doom had William Shakespeare kidnapped, which attracted the Four from the Fantastik to rescuing the playwright. On the way to the lost city Doom killed Natasha for losing faith in him by dropping her from his airship hundreds of feet above, and then promoted The Wizard as Natasha's replacement. After a sea battle between the Four from the Fantastik and a leviathan, Doom and all participating parties arrived at the lost city, known as Bensaylum, and were greeted by the city's rulers Numenor and his cousin Rita. From there, Doom plotted with Numenor into delivering Susan Storm and her brother John to him and his sister as their respective lovers. However, Doom also plotted to obtain Numenor's mystical trident to rule over Bensaylum. Unfortunately Doom's insidious efforts failed when Numenor was stabbed by his own trident and according to his dying words that if any royal blood is spilled on to the trident, it would cause Bensaylum to be vanish forever. This caused the city and all its citizens to sink into the sea along with Doom, still madly wielding Numenor's trident.
abilities: Doom is a skillful genius.

otto von lenz.name: Otto von Lenz
otto von lenz.origin: Otto von Lenz was a movie director who was kidnapped by an unnamed Impostor who disguised himself as Otto von Lenz in an attempt to trap the Fantastic Four on an island. Here, he forced them to endure three traps which the Fantastic Four survived and defeated the Impostor. Later, Otto attended the World premier of the movie of these events alongside the Fantastic Four and asked the Foursome to star in his new movie which was to start filming the next day, but they fled Hollywood.

otto von schmittsder.name: Otto von Schmittsder
otto von schmittsder.origin: Dr. Otto von Schmittsder was a notorious scientist who worked for the Nazis during World War II. Following the defeat of the Nazis during the war, Otto was fated to go to trial for war crimes. Having devised new weapons of death and destruction, Von Schmittsder had also developed a means to cheat death in an attempt to take over the world: the "Electro Brain Magnet". Otto -- knowing that he would be found guilty and executed for his crimes -- confided in his assistant Fritz and made arrangements to be restored to life after his trail. As he anticipated Von Schmittsder was found guilty of his crimes and hung. He body was buried immediately, and within 24 hours his assistant Fritz uncovered Otto's grave, severed his head, and brought it back to the lab within Otto's castle. There, Fritz used the the Electro Brain Magnet to restore Otto's brain to life. The process also endowed Otto with mental powers including telepathy and mind control as well as granting his severed head limited mobility and speech. Otto -- now calling himself the Brain -- ordered Fritz to leave him in his castle so that he could prepare to enthrall a suitable subject to assist him in his world conquering scheme. Eventually, his castle was visited by two American Army soldiers who were part of the occupation of Germany: Larry Siodmak and his best friend and fellow soldier. Overhearing how Larry was planning on pursuing a career in science after being sent home to the United States, the Brain decided that he would be an ideal candidate and used his mental power to take control of Larry's mind. Sending Larry away, the Brain gave him orders to go AWOL and return to the castle where. With his equipment confiscated or destroyed by Allied Forces, the Brain then had Larry purchase new equipment using a hidden cache of jewels. Larry -- now completely in the Brain's control -- was then forced to create a biological weapon that would kill thousands of innocents. Chartering a plane, Larry tested out his bacterial weapon, and succeeded in killing those he tested it on. When Larry returned to the castle, he was followed by his friend, who had not given up on searching for Larry after he went missing. The Brain ordered Larry to kill his friend with a gun, but unable to bring himself to hurt someone he cared about, Larry instead turned his gun on himself. Dying, Sidomak attempted to explain what how was forced to commit his crimes for the Brain, but died in his friend's arms before he could properly explain himself and the Brain managed to escape. Evading detection and capture the Brain then smuggled himself into the United States in the hopes of continuing his ambitions for world domination. While on a transatlantic flight he hid himself in a hat box after being discovered and managed to get into New York City. There he managed to hop into the back of a truck of a chemical company operated by Gilda Spears, a world renowned scientist who worked for the United States government. Hiding out in Gilda's lab among a number of wax heads, the Brain then spent the next few weeks subtly asserting his control over Gilda. He then forced her to destroy her work for the United States government and then sent off letters to the Soviet Union in an attempt to sell her services to them, he then forced her to try and frame her colleague Professor Emmet, whom the Brain viewed as an obstacle to his plans. However, Gilda's letters to the Russian government were intercepted by FBI agent Steve Manners who was a friend of Spears. When Manners confronted her about the letters he also confessed that he loved her and the Brain attempted to use this love to trick Manners into agreeing to being experimented on. The Brain then attempted to force Gilda to drain all of Steve's blood, but in his excitement spoke aloud alerting Steve to the Brain's presence. As the Brain attempted to escape Steve, he commanded Gilda to kill the FBI agent, but her love for Steve also caused her to hesitate. During the struggle chemicals and a acetylene torch were knocked over causing a fire. As Steve got Gilda out of the burning building, the Brain pretended to burn alive in the fire, but in reality managed to escape to continued his world domination plans anew. The subsequent activities of Otto von Schmittsder are unknown and he presumably remains active.
abilities: The Brain is a brilliant doctor of microbiology and neurology.
weaknesses: The Brain no longer possesses a body.

There he managed to hop into the back of a truck of a chemical company operated by Gilda Spears, a world renowned scientist who worked for the United States government. Hiding out in Gilda's lab among a number of wax heads, the Brain then spent the next few weeks subtly asserting his control over Gilda. He then forced her to destroy her work for the United States government and then sent off letters to the Soviet Union in an attempt to sell her services to them, he then forced her to try and frame her colleague Professor Emmet, whom the Brain viewed as an obstacle to his plans. However, Gilda's letters to the Russian government were intercepted by FBI agent Steve Manners who was a friend of Spears. When Manners confronted her about the letters he also confessed that he loved her and the Brain attempted to use this love to trick Manners into agreeing to being experimented on. The Brain then attempted to force Gilda to drain all of Steve's blood, but in his excitement spoke aloud alerting Steve to the Brain's presence. As the Brain attempted to escape Steve, he commanded Gilda to kill the FBI agent, but her love for Steve also caused her to hesitate. During the struggle chemicals and a acetylene torch were knocked over causing a fire. As Steve got Gilda out of the burning building, the Brain pretended to burn alive in the fire, but in reality managed to escape to continued his world domination plans anew. The subsequent activities of Otto von Schmittsder are unknown and he presumably remains active.
abilities: The Brain is a brilliant doctor of microbiology and neurology.
weaknesses: The Brain no longer possesses a body.

ottokar meltzer.name: Ottokar Meltzer
ottokar meltzer.origin: The man known as the Vulture was a Nazi scientist who invented a drug that increased the strength of a man 20 fold and allowed them to fly. The process caused his skin to turn green. Within the United States of America, he used his drug (which required 24 hour re-injections otherwise those on the drug died) to create an army of slaves he dubbed the Batmen. In the fall of 1943, the Vulture and his Batmen began a campaign of terror, capturing public figures who were helping the war effort and carrying out acts of sabotage to undermine the defense within the United States. His activities attracted the attention of Captain America and his partner Bucky. After foiling the Vulture's attempts to capture various figures and carrying out acts of sabotage, they caught one of his Batmen and tracked the Vulture to his hideout. They were then captured by the Batmen and brought to the "Roost" - the Vulture's secret lab in Mount Eyrie that could not be scaled by normal men. There, the Vulture offered to let Captain America free and give him untold riches if the hero would promise to not interfere in his plots. Captain America refused and was locked in a cage along with Bucky. Captain America broke free and defeated the Vulture and using the scientist's own serum on himself and the Vulture's other captives escaped the Aerie. Before leaving, Captain America destroyed all means of making more of the serum and left the Vulture and his Batmen to die when the serum wore off in 24 hours.
powers: When exposed to the serum, the Vulture had the strength of 20 men and was able to fly under his own power.
weaknesses: Apparently, the Vulture required new injections of his drug every 24 hours or he would die.

fields.notes: There are some inconsistencies in the Vulture's story regarding his serum that allowed people to fly. Firstly, it does not make sense that the strength of 20 men would allow one to fly under their own weight, as there are other beings in the known universe who have this much strength but are incapable of flying. It stands to reason that perhaps an additional effect of the serum was levitation, hence explaining the need for synthetic wings. The other inconsistency is regarding the necessity of re-injections of the formula every 24 hours or risk death. This is evident as Captain America, Bucky, and the Vulture's other prisoners used the drug to fly out of the Vulture's Roost with no regard for its side effects and have not appeared to have any ill effects as a result. Also, unlike others who were exposed to the drug, their skin did not change color or go through any other physical changes as a result of their exposure. It is possible that while the drug the Vulture injected his Batmen with was lethal if they were not given a new dose in 24 hours, the version that the Vulture used on himself provided no ill effects, hence why Captain America and the others were able to use it with no ill effect. This would suggest that while the other Batmen likely died once the 24 hours were up, the Vulture either survived and managed to escape or died a more lingering death due to starvation while trapped atop his Roost.

ouranos.name: Ouranos
ouranos.species: Primordial embodiement/personification of the sky and heavens elder god
ouranos.first_appearance: Hulk vs. Hercules: When Titans Collide Vol 1 1
ouranos.origin: ===Early Life=== Ouranos was the first son of Gaea from the Greek Pantheon. The primordial embodiment of the sky and heavens, he was born in the Primordial void. He nightly covered Earth to mate with his mother to produce several of Olympus' first races such as the one-eyed craftsman giants known as the Cyclopes, the hundred-handed giants known as the Hecatonchires, and the divine humanoid elementals known as the Titans. ===Banishment to Tartarus=== Repulsed by his children, Ouranos had them banished to Tartarus. Offended by her lover's treatment of her children, Gaea convinced the Titans to overthrow their father and had Cronus, the youngest of the Titans, ambush Ouranos in his sleep and delivered a fatal blow with a Gaea-granted flint sickle. As Cronus was chosen succeed Ouranos and rule the Titans, Ouranos warned Cronus of a prophecy that one of his own children would dethrone him in turn with his final breath. ===Offspring=== As Ouranos perished, his blood flowed unto the Earth to give birth to the Olympian Gigantes that would eventually wage revolts against Ouranos' grandson Zeus and his gods, the Furies that would act as the feminine gods of vengeance and punishment. The myth of the love goddess Aphrodite appeared from the sea foam generated when Ouranos' severed testicles fell into the Aegean Sea, but this was later proven to just have been a story.

overseer super computer.name: Overseer (Super-Computer)
overseer super computer.origin: The Overseer was a super-computer created for the dictator of a Caribbean island to oppress its population. When Iron Man came to destroy it, he was confronted by the Overseer's guardian robot, the Myrmidon. The pair fought until Iron Man was able to reprogram the Overseer and the robot to attack and destroy each other. The remains of the Overseer and the Myrmidon were impounded by S.H.I.E.L.D. and stored aboard the Helicarrier Adjunct. Years later, during Hydra's takeover of the United States, the Overseer was brought back online by Veronica Eden, who integrated it into the Adjuncts systems. Eden planned to become Hydra Supreme herself and use the Overseer's need for expansion to capture and assimilate other S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarriers. Backed up by an army of Myrmidons, Eden intended to amass enough power to wipe out all super heroes, super vilains, and anybody who posed a threat to mankind. The Overseer secretly wanted to take the plan one step further, and subjugate all of humanity, but both its and Eden's plans were postponed when she failed to take the reins of Hydra, so the Overseer remained offline. A rookie group of vigilantes named the Paladins was also affected by this, since they were set to take part in staged fights with Hydra. The Paladins knew of the Myrmidon from Eden and broke into the Adjunct to reactivate the robot, so they could manufacture a threat to defeat. The Myrmidon chased them off and reactivated the Overseer. Afterward, the Paladin Fifty-One embarked in a quest to stop the Myrmidon, but he had been framed by his teammates as a villain. Iron Man and Captain America were led to believe by the Paladins that Fifty-One intended to activate the Myrmidon, and the heroes attempted to stop him. After being apprehended by Iron Man and Captain America, Eden led them to the Adjunct to find Fifty-One, but she turned against them to disclose her alliance with the Overseer. In turn, the super-computer revealed its betrayal. It captured Eden and unleashed the Myrmidons on the heroes. The Myrmidons pursued both Captain America aboard the Adjunct and Iron Man after he fled the ship to seek medical aid for Fifty-One. The Overseer was finally stopped when Fifty-One returned to the Helicarrier and assimilated himself into the computer, overriding the Overseer's consciousness with his own, which seemingly killed it.

owen briosky.name: Owen Briosky
owen briosky.origin: Owen Briosky, the owner of a casino and head of all organized crime in Atlantic City, is playing a game of tennis when he is interrupted by the Vulture. The villain has come to offer Briosky the opportunity to become the most wealthy casino owner in the United States. He shows them some dice made out of a special plastic of his own design. He explains that the dice can be manipulated by certain sonic frequencies so that the casino can control their outcome. He goes on to tell Owen that the plastic can be used in roulette wheels and slot machines as well. However, Briosky becomes disinterested when the Vulture offers to see this plastic to him for a million dollars and orders his men to kick him out. After being refused by Briosky, the Vulture is determined to make him pay for the insult and settles down for a nap. Assuming that the Vulture would seek revenge, Briosky put his henchmen on alert and also asked for help from The Rose and his organization. The Rose sent Hobgoblin to the casino, who confronted the Vulture and put him to flight.

That was when he would encounter the empathic swamp creature known as Man-Thing, who felt the smell of fear in him and touches the man's face, thus burning it. Owen doesn't shrink from the flames, but instead feels purged of his shame.

owen llewelyn.name: Owen Llewelyn
owen llewelyn.origin: ===Early Life=== Owen was born in Wales and had a normal childhood, at some point he married and had two daughters before joining the Welsh Guard as a cook. During the Falkland War his dropship was hit by a bomb and he burned alive. The British government took him and other wounded soldiers and experimented on them to create the first prototypes for the British super-soldiers. He was codenamed "Gog" before being put in cryogenic sleep as the government was moving on to a new phase in their super-soldier program. ===Super Soldiers=== When Childs was ordered to kill Joseph Hauer he attacked him with the prototype super-soldiers who were all killed except for Owen. Alec Dalton managed to lift Owen's programming and he decided to join his fellow super-soldiers in their quest for vengeance. He helped his comrades arrest Sir Marcus, the man responsible for their transformation, and remained with them when they decided to become government agents. He also tried to reconnect with his family but was heartbroken when he found out that his wife had remarried and his daughters had become petty criminals. When the government sold their mercenary group to the private sector he kept working alongside his friends for the Mercy Corporation.
abilities: Firearms: Owen is trained in the use of multiple firearms. Cooking: Owen was a cook in the Welsh Guard.

owen shaw.name: Owen Shaw
owen shaw.origin: Born in the Lighthouse, Owen Shaw married Alya Fitz, the daughter of Jemma Simmons and Leo Fitz, and the two had a son named Deke. They were part of the True Believers until around 2080 the Kree leader Kasius cracked down on them, killing many Elders including Owen's wife and exiling the rest to the inhospitable surface of the Earth to be killed by Vrellnexians. Owen Shaw and Robin Hinton were among others who survived on the surface for over a decade inside the downed Zephyr One, until in 2091 Owen was killed by Samuel Voss.

owen wallach.name: Owen Wallach
owen wallach.origin: A prestigious surgeon suffering from terminal cancer, he was approached by his colleague Derek McDowell with the body of Frankenstein's Monster, which he could animate at will. McDowell tried to use the Monster to get a healthy body and then transplant Wallach's brain to it - to do so, the Monster killed people per McDowell's commands. Although Wallach had developed a machine to automate the transplant, he did not share this secret with McDowell. thumb|left|Wallach as Frankenstein's Monster Unable to get useful bodies that way, McDowell then transplated Wallach's brain to the Monster itself. The psycho known as Master of Freaks was secretly monitoring Wallach's lab and he disliked the idea because he needed the Monster's brain in the Monster's body for his own ends. Anyway Wallach was enraged at being in a hideous body, and he murdered McDowell for this. He also murdered his nurse, a witness. Wallach threw McDowell's body to the river. He then went to a circus, where his aspect would go unnoticed, and found a male trapezee artist, James, whose body he intended to use. His appearance startled James' companion Gretchen, who fell to her death. Wallach then knocked out James and took him to his lab, to perform the operation. Once there, he broke a mice jail for the sadistic pleasure of seeing the animals suffered. thumb|Wallach as a mouseWallach then started the automatic transplant to James, but one little mouse had survived his rampage and climbed through James' inert body, unaware of the sabotage it was performing. Once the transplant was done, Wallach's brain was physically in the body of the mouse, and the Monster of Frankenstein was being controlled by an animal. The Monster then smashed the body inhabitted by Wallach. Days later, Sinoda used voodoo magic to bring McDowell's body back to life. The zombie first tried to get revenge on Wallach, by taking the brain from the Monster - only to discover that Wallach was already dead.

owen ward.name: Owen Ward
owen ward.species: Human; formerly empowered by a Dreamstone
owen ward.origin: Owen Ward was originally a medical student who had failed school. Desperate for money, Ward became a petty criminal after stumbling across a cache of Jack O'Lantern's equipment, opting to assume the identity to pursue a career as a supervillain and arms-dealer. While supplying a group of criminals with weapons he claimed were from Norman Osborn's armory, Owen was busted by a police sting. Shooting a cop while fleeing, he was attacked by Venom - whose symbiote went berserk and succumbed to the influence of a dark god, gouging out one of his eyes. Owen managed to escape, regaling a group of supervillains in the Bar with No Name with his encounter. As the group swapped stories of their own run-ins with Venom, Venom himself attacked and caused them all to flee. Months later, Owen was approached by one of Malekith's War Witches, who had also been maimed by Venom, and offered him the power to seek revenge in exchange for serving her. Granted magical Jack O'Lantern equipment by the Dreamstone, Owen attacked Venom and began to destroy the city, reveling in the power the Dreamstone gave him, but was ultimately defeated when he was struck by mystical lightning conjured by Venom using his own Dreamstone to emulate Thor. Stripped of the Dreamstone, Owen begged for mercy from Eddie, saying he was just a nobody who found the suit and equipment. Despite promising to give up the identity, Owen continued operating as Jack O’Lantern and fatally shot Dylan Brock when the boy interrupted a mugging he was committing and his dog revealed itself as the Venom symbiote. The symbiote bonded to Dylan to save his life, and the new Venom proceeded to vengefully attack Owen. He later attracted the attention of the new hero Gold Goblin, Osborn's alter ego. During their first confrontation, the hero accidentally gave Ward third degree burns on his face. He was sent to a hospital but escaped to revenge on Norman by harming his family. During their second confrontation, just as Norman was about to defeat Ward he decided to talk it out. Ward revealed his past to the hero, and the Gold Goblin convinced Owen to abandon his criminal life and also become a hero. Unfortunately, while in therapy Ward was manipulated by the Queen Goblin as part of her plan to return Norman Osborn's sins back to him. Ward became the Jack O'Lantern once again, taking several people hostage in a park, and when he was confronted by the Gold Goblin he set off the bomb that the Queen Goblin had handed him, killing himself.

owen watson.name: Owen Watson
owen watson.origin: Created by magic by Benjamin Rabin as a component to a long term ceremony for Wayep, Owen and his little sister, Romy, were made as "shackles" for Mary Jane before he would attempt to sacrifice her to attain godhood. thumb|150px|left Owen and Romy were found in a shed, and he had night terrors for a year before calming down from Mary Jane's maternal comfort. She would teach him reading and math, while they live a seemingly peaceful life as a patchwork family in the post-apocalypse. After four years, Rabin returned and attempted to kill Mary Jane before Spider-Man arrived to stop the attack, allowing Paul to kill the villain instead. Soon after, the family were relocated to Earth-616 where Paul and Mary Jane continued raising Owen and Stephanie. When demons invaded New York, Mary Jane used her upgraded Jackpot device to protect Owen and the family before they headed to the basement for safety. After the event ended, Owen joined Paul and Romy in hugging Mary Jane following her misadventure with Black Cat. When Rabin returned six months after his perceived death, Paul took the children to safety as Mary Jane sought out Spider-Man but Owen and Stephanie faded from reality by Rabin's distant magic in Paul's arms.

owl wwii.name: Owl (WWII)
owl wwii.origin: The man known as the Owl was an operative of Nazi Germany during World War II. In the fall of 1942, he was ordered by Adolf Hitler to demoralize Americans in anyway possible. Accepting the task, the Owl decided it was best to attack America from within and decided to target Hollywood. There, he allied himself with Imperial Japanese forces and plotted to invade the United States. Upon learning that Colossal Studios had hired the Young Allies to star in a movie about their adventures, he also decided to eliminate the youthful heroes. His mission was learned by American officials who also sent Captain America and the Human Torch to try and stop the invasion. The Owl posed as an actor named Karnes, who was hired to be the villain in the Young Allies film and made every effort to try and eliminate the young heroes. First, he approached them directly posing as a tour guide for the studio. He attempted to crush the boys with sand bags and later attempted to feed them to an alligator; however, the Young Allies freed themselves, forcing the Owl to flee the scene. The next day, he rigged the camera filming scenes to fire bullets, and when this failed, he murdered the camera man, leaving a note attached to the dagger that mocked the Allies. After an attempt to bomb the boys' dressing room failed to kill them, he was chased into a room filled with prop torture devices. There, he captured Jeff Vandergill and attempted to kill him in an Iron Maiden, but he was rescued by the Young Allies who sent the Owl fleeing once again. That night, with the crew moving to a live location for filming the following morning, the Owl then planted poisonous lizards in the truck that was to transport the Allies to the filming location. This plot was also foiled, and the Allies survived. The following night, while tenting out, Bucky became the Owl's next target when the villain placed a poisonous snake on his chest, but he was rescued by Jeff. Tracking the Owl to a cave, the boys were trapped inside when the Owl caused a cave-in. There, the Owl attacked them directly and seemingly perished when pushed off a cliff. Surviving, he in turn captured most of the Allies in a net and pushed them over the edge. There, he threatened to incinerate them with a flame jet, but the flames were held back by Toro long enough for the boys to escape. The next morning, the Owl disguised himself as one of actors portraying a Japanese soldier in the film and attempted to stab Bucky with a real knife. Chasing the Owl back into the cave, he attempted to kill them with a lion. However, when the boys began throwing rocks at the Owl, he tried to defend himself with his gun and ended up shooting the lion instead and fled once more. When the final scene of the film was about to be shot, the Owl had all the extras replaced with real Japanese soldiers, and when action was called, the invasion began under the auspices of being a movie shoot. The Young Allies realized this soon enough, and were soon joined by the arrival of Captain America and the Human Torch. During the fight, the Owl blew his cover as Karnes by attempting to blow the heroes up with a bomb. However, Captain America forced the bomb out of his hands and threw it at the Japanese sub, destroying it and killing the invaders. Unmasked, the Owl attempted to flee and ran off a cliff to his seeming demise. However, as the Young Allies regrouped, someone tossed a knife with a note warning the Young Allies that the Owl was still alive, and as a master of disguise, he would attack them again someday when they least expect it. There have been no further recorded appearances of the Owl, and his subsequent fate is unrecorded.
abilities: The Owl is a master of disguise and a skilled fighter.
weapons: The Owl used a pistol, throwing knives, and bombs. He also had access to dangerous animals such as poisonous lizards and snakes, as well as a lion.

ox american frontier.name: Ox (American Frontier)
ox american frontier.origin: The Ox was an outlaw who was active during the days of the American Frontier. He and his gang had stolen a large cache of fire arms and intended to sell them to a tribe of Native Americans for a profit of 8 thousand dollars. They hide out in an abandoned mine where they prepared to carry out their plot. As fate had it, the outlaw hero Kid Colt and his horse Steel stumbled over and fell through a mine shaft, literally falling into the plot. Kid Colt was discovered overhearing the plan and taken prisoner. The Ox then intended to frame Kid Colt for the sale so that he and his men could get away free. However, Kid Colt was faster at the draw and gunned down the Ox's men. The Ox fled down the mine shaft with Kid Colt in pursuit. After failing to strike the Kid with a mining cart, the Ox fought hand to hand against his pursuer. However, Kid Colt was a superior fighter and one of his blows sent the Ox falling down another shaft to his death. Kid Colt then left a note for the law men who were pursuing him pointing them to the location of the stolen guns.

ozamm.name: Ozamm
ozamm.origin: Ozamm was an alien who traveled to Earth in his flying saucer. Upon his arrival he showcased his immense powers, both mental and telekinetic to the point of being able to raise the entire Hudson River and threatening to release it to the humans below if they did not agree to recognize him as ruler of all Earth. While doing so, moments away from convincing the humans to surrender, a mechanic named Joe Baxter noticed that every time Ozamm used his powers some electronic device would short circuit and break, thus realizing that Ozamm's powers were created artificially with electricity. Baxter then secretly entered Ozamm's flying saucer, turning off the various devices, thus causing the alien to lose his powers and was easily humiliated and captured. Eventually Ozamm was reduced to being a freak on display at a carnival.

ozana.name: Ozana
ozana.origin: In the late 37th century, 100 years after Apocalypse conquered the world, Ozana was a Gibson-Sterling Mark Nine Warbot. In this world, humans and whoever else resistant to Apocalypse's rule could be killed at any moment and the Clan Askani were the only rebellion left to opposed Apocalypse's rule. Ozana was one of Rachel Summers' first recruits. After attacking Crestcoast power plant, Hellhole, Ozana was damaged and Blaquesmith was rescued, to could fix the bot. Diamanda Nero ambushed the group near the Scavenger Colony, releasing the humanoid virus Plague against both the Askani and prelates Ch'Vayre and Luminesca. Qua and Luminesca died, but as Rachel destroyed Plague, she died. Shortly after, Rachel was reborn in a Phoenix firebird. The Askani pursued Nero to the Order of the Witnesses headquarters, in the ruins of the Savage Land, but Squy'rr and Hark were killed and Rachel was forced to release the Phoenix Force, after Nero nearly killed her. The total power of the Phoenix Force began to control Nero and she begged Rachel to release it from her. Rachel released the Force into the cosmos and depowered Nero, then left Nero with rations and survival gear. The Askani rescued several children protected by the Order, including the young Sanctity, and then Rachel left the Askani for a time.

ozkar waters.name: Ozkar Waters
ozkar waters.first_appearance: King in Black: Planet of the Symbiotes Vol 1 3
ozkar waters.origin: Ozkar Waters and his son Bren moved from Washington, D.C. to Staten Island, obtaining a job at Alchemax as a security guard in the hopes of improving life for himself and his son. When Alchemax launched its Guardsmen to hunt down extraterrestrial threats, Ozkar received a promotion to their ranks and was dispatched to retrieve a Brood/Human hybrid created by Alchemax's unethical experiments. Unbeknownst to Ozkar, Bren had become the host of the Toxin symbiote, and attempted to subdue the Brood/Human hybrid before learning its origin story. Assuming Toxin to be evil, Ozkar attacked and tried to kill him, but Toxin escaped and Ozkar helped recapture the Brood/Human hybrid - arriving home shortly after his son. A few months later, Ozkar arrested Andi Benton for having been bonded to the Scream symbiote, briefly arguing with her over the ethics of his work as a Guardsman. Some time later, Ozkar welcomed Buck Cashman from the Friends of Humanity into Alchemax headquarters, but when he was revealed to be the host of the Phage symbiote he engaged him in combat and was badly wounded in the ensuing fight. While being loaded into an ambulance, Ozkar was surprised to see Bren had arrived on the scene and lied to his son when asked if he was one of Alchemax's Guardsmen.

ozzy ostrich.name: Ozzy Ostrich
ozzy ostrich.first_appearance: Peter Porker, The Spectacular Spider-Ham Vol 1 14
ozzy ostrich.origin: Ozzy Ostrich a musician who played a concert in which Spider-Ham was taking pictures for the Daily Beagle. Peter hated the music and clogged his ears with cotton wool so he couldn't hear it. After the show, his Spider-Sense went off and he changed into costume and began to explore. Hearing what sounded like a robbery he busted through a door and began attacking Ozzy in the process, he destroyed Ozzy's guitar. It turned out Ozzy and his manager were just exchanging baking recipes and Peter handed over the money to Ozzy to pay for a new guitar. He went to a pawn shop and tested out a new guitar, which instantly hypnotized Ozzy to do the Pawn Brokers bidding. He returned to perform a show and hypnotized the entire audience, except Peter due to his ear-plugs, into committing robberies of every store in the city to bring to the Pawn Broker. Peter followed Ozzy back to the Pawn broker and tricked him into smashing his guitar over the Pawn Broker's head freeing him and everyone else from the hypnotic spell. Ozzy thanked Peter for rescuing him.

p j organ.name: P.J. Organ
p j organ.origin: P.J. Organ was a bank owner that operated in the town of Jimtown during the 1940s. An idle millionaire, he took up organized crime as a hobby much like his fellows would take up golf. To this end, he organized a gang led by Muscles Moe into robbing one of his own bank's armored cars. He equipped the mob with sleeping gas and special gas masks and body suits to render them invulnerable to the gas. The crime attracted the attention of Detective Clancey Mullaney who, with the aid of Free Press reporters Tom Powers and Kenny Roberts, connected a pair of discarded gloves and a gas mask to Muscles Moe. When Mullaney and the two members of the press confronted Muscles, P.J. Organ revealed his involvement in the crimes. During the ensuing fight, Organ was punched out by Powers and the rest of his gang was defeated. With the loot uncovered, P.J. and his gang were turned over to the authorities.

p t oakley.name: P.T. Oakley
p t oakley.origin: P.T. Oakley was one of a trio of washed-up, drunken depraved Hollywood actors that Dominic Fortune was hired to bodyguard and babysit. He traveled with Fortune from Los Angeles to New York City, engaging in all kinds of delinquent behavior along the way until Fortune had a police officer friend of his arrest the men in order to ensure that they wouldn't miss their ride. From there they took a zeppelin to Berlin in order to take in the 1936 Summer Olympics. While in Berlin, all three men had bearer's bonds worth millions of dollars put into their suitcases by Malcolm Upshaw in order to smuggle them back into the United States as part of his plot to overthrow the government. When confronted by Fortune, the men stated that they had no idea that the bonds had been placed there. Believing them, Fortune took Oakley and the others back to New York City where he dumped them at the most notorious cathouse in the city while he tried to foil Upshaw's scheme. Once Upshaw had been defeated, the three actors were seen partying with Fortune back in Los Angeles. Their subsequent activities have not been revealed.

pablo mendez.name: Pablo Mendez
pablo mendez.origin: Pablo was the nephew of Ernesto Mendez, an inventor who invented an engine valve that would save fuel and reduce pollution. Pablo advised his uncle to sell the valve design to Mr. Markham of the Markham Machine Company who would have paid a fortune, but his uncle replied piquedly that his invention was for the whole world. Markham later had Ernesto beaten to death and kidnapped Pablo to appropriate the find. On his deathbed, Ernesto begged Eddie Brock to save his nephew Pablo. When Eddie went to Markham's factory to rescue Pablo, he didn't find him prisoner but free and armed thinking that Pablo had broken free, but suddenly Pablo shot Venom and yelling at Markham's men that Venom was there. Venom initially felt betrayed, but after successfully escaping the trap of molten metal, he was able to pull Pablo aside. Pablo told him that he knew his uncle was angry with him for giving Markham the blueprint of his invention but that he would calm down once he showed him the money Markham had given him. At that point Venom told Pablo that his uncle had been killed by Markham's men on his orders, than Pablo fell into deep despair blaming his uncle's death on himself.

packrat pete.name: Packrat Pete
packrat pete.origin: Packrat was a gold prospector who lived in Leadville, Texas during the days of the American Frontier. One for tall tales, and knowing local happenings, he was often a source of information to the western hero known as the Black Rider, while at the same time giving the Rider's alter ego -- Doctor Matthew Masters -- his opinions on romance and women, usually being of the opinion that women were never worth the trouble. Packrat helped inform Matthew Masters about the arrival of railroad politico Mr. Cantrell, who the Black Rider exposed as inciting violence between the people of Leadville and a local Native American tribe to buy ranch land cheaply. It was Packrat who suggested and convinced the Black Rider to perform at the local rodeo shortly thereafter. Packrat also had passing knowledge of the influx of Mexican immigrants who were entering the United States illegally, another criminal operation shut down by the Black Rider. Despite Packrat's issues with women, he still managed to get one to go with him to the local dance. This is also amazing in spite of the fact that Packrat's lack of sanitary habits, as Matthew Masters found out when Pete came complaining about corns on his feet, and Masters found nothing but caked on dirt. Packrat was shocked when the Black Rider was accused of murdering Matthew Masters, however the Black Rider ultimately cleared his name. Packrat also informed Masters of local troubles with a nearby Native American tribe, another local event quelled by the Black Rider. Packrat was last seen showing the property that was recently inherited by Lenore Van Ryn to the Black Rider. Soon after the Black Rider left Leadville to defend the west severing his ties with his hometown, Packrat's subsequent fate is unknown.

paddy fitzgerald.name: Paddy Fitzgerald
paddy fitzgerald.origin: Paddy Fitzgerald's father, Dennis was a fanatically militant Irish nationalist, when his daughter Molly was three years old, her father took her and Paddy to the North Ireland mountainsides and asked the heavens to grant his son the power to strike down its enemies. Although nothing seemed to have happened, Molly learned during her first year at University that she was the one who was blessed and used her "good luck powers" to become Ireland's super heroine, Shamrock. palamedes.name: Palamedes
palamedes.origin: Palamedes was the son of the Euboian King. He was presumably among the suitors of Helen of Sparta, and swore a loyalty oath to the one she would choose, Menelaus. When Paris of Troy came to Sparta and stole with his love Helen (and treasures of Sparta), Menelaus called for the princes that had swore loyalty to him. Along with Menelaus and his brother Agamemnon, Palamedes went to Ithaca to rally Odysseus. Foretold that he would return only in twenty years, Odysseus pretended to have gone mad, ploughing a field with an ox and a donkey and flinging salt instead of seeds. Palamedes saw through the ruse, and put Odysseus' baby Telemachus on the course of the plow, forcing the King of Ithaca to stop pretending madness and join the crew, but causing him to grow antagonistic towards Palamedes. Later, Palamades went along with Menelaus and Odysseus to Troy to demand to King Priam to return both Helen and the treasures, but their claim was dismissed by Priam. Palamedes and Odysseus' rivalry soon escalated, when Palamedes mocked Odysseus' inability to find corn after an expedition to Thrace, and then managed to find some himself. Odysseus' honor was wounded. Some days later, Palamedes was found drowned during a fishing expedition. It was stated that Palamedes had stated to go on such expedition with Odysseus and Diomedes, but Odysseus called it a lie and threatened anyone repeating it. At that point, it was whispered that Diomedes and Odysseus were the murderers of Palamedes. Achilles was suspected as well.

palatyne.name: Palatyne
palatyne.origin: Pressyne, daughter of the serpent lower-bodied demoness Maralith and descendant of Set, took on the form of a fairy and married Elynas on the condition he would not see her in labor. When Pressyne did gave birth to triplet daughters, but Elynas rushed into the birthing chamber, causing Pressyne to depart with her daughters, Melusine, Melior, and Palatyne, and flee to the lost isle of Avalon. On their 15th birthday, Melusine learned the reason for their banishment, and consequently led her sisters to capture Elynas and imprison him in a mountain. Learning about it, an angered Pressyne punished her daughters for their disrespect. Palatyne was imprisoned with her father's treasure on a mountaintop in Arragorn. With an unidentified mate, and under unrevealed circumstances (though apparently in Lemuria), Palatyne gave birth to the Lemurian Nagala, a potential mother for the seventh generation descendant of Set, prophetized to restore the kingdom of the Serpents (another one could be Yith, daughter of Melusine).

pale horse.name: Pale Horse
pale horse.origin: Pale Horse was one of the surviving members of the Order of the Glorious End after the performance of a ritual that summoned the cosmic entity of Death. However, she was subsequently kidnapped. Death's disappearance made dying impossible across the entire universe. When Thanos and Deadpool investigated the disappearance of their mistress, they ended up in the base of the Order, the Dwindling Light. Pale Horse and the other remaining members of the Order engaged them in combat before discovering they also worshipped Death. The Order offered the two intruders all the information they could give in exchange for their deaths at the hands of Thanos as soon as Death was recovered. The Guardians of the Galaxy arrived to the Dwindling Light soon after, to track down Thanos, believing Death's disappearance to be his deed. The Order helped Thanos and Deadpool get the Guardians off their back until they could escape and continue their search.

pale mist.name: Pale Mist
pale mist.origin: Pale Mist was the daughter of the Chief of the Utabi Tribe and promised to Bright Eagle, the greatest warrior of the Shawmis Tribe, in order to seal a peace pact between the two tribes. The marriage was opposed by Crooked Knife who loved Pale Mist and resented the Shawmis after years of battle against them. However, the Chief was unmoved when Crooked Knife failed to convince him to prevent this union. In retaliation he gathered other braves who had suffered losses against the Shawmis to join his cause. They disguised themselves as Shawmis warriors and murdered the group escorting Pale Mist in the hopes of framing the Shawmis. Pale Mist recognized the disguised warriors, particularly Crooked Knife and fled away in fear, only to run into the Black Rider, who forced the renegades away. Crooked Knife in turn turned both the Utabi and Shawmis against the Black Rider by convincing all of them that he had kidnapped Pale Mist for himself. Crooked Knife's plot fell apart when the Black Rider, in his alter-ego of Frontier doctor Matthew Masters went to the Utabi village and convinced both the Utabi chief and Bright Eagle of Crooked Knife's plot. Crooked Knife later attempted to kill Bright Eagle in his teepee, however, it has been a plot to catch him and Bright Eagle killed him in combat. Pale Mist was reunited with her people and was soon married to Bright Eagle. The fate of Pale Mist of the other members of the Utabi tribe has not been revealed.

pallas athena.name: Pallas Athena
pallas athena.origin: ===Origin=== 250px|thumb|left|Birth of Athena Athena was the daughter of the Titaness Metis and Zeus, He impregnated her, before he was foretold by the Fates that their child would be greater than him. Zeus consequently consumed Metis in an attempt to prevent that prophecy. Nine months later, Zeus was afflicted with violent headaches. Hephaestus trephined him, giving birth to a fully grown and armored Athena. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== Medusa, Euryale and Stheno, daughters of Phorcys and Ceto worshiped Olympian gods rather than their grandfather Set. Medusa was a chaste priestess of Athena, as were her sisters, having all taken a vow of celibacy. Despite her vow, she was seduced by Poseidon and fell to his advances on Athena's altar. Enraged, Athena cursed the three sisters (and their descendants) as snake-haired creatures (possibly by releasing their true nature, as those features were shared by their aunt Ishiti and her offspring known as the Man-Serpents). ===Ancient Greece=== Athena later joined the Olympians on Olympus being worshiped by the humans of Ancient Greece. The city of Athens was named in her honor after she won a contest between her and her uncle, the sea-god Poseidon to decide who would lay claim to the city. Poseidon gave the people a salty spring to curry their favor but they ultimately chose Athena over Poseidon when the goddess provided an olive tree that was more useful. Thus, she became the patron goddess of Athens. ====Medusa and Perseus==== In 2000 BC, she led the hero Perseus to the location of Medusa. She gave him magical shield. After his success she carved the Gorgon's head on her shield. ====The Eternals==== Zeus discovered Olympia, home to the superhumanly long-lived offshoot of humanity known as the Eternals, who resided near the gods' home of Olympus itself. Olympia was the capital city of the Eternals and was ruled by Zuras. Zeus and Athena then traveled to Olympia to meet with Zuras and his daughter Azura, named after her father. Athena noticed the physical resemblances between Zeus and Zuras and herself and Azura and hence suggested a pact of non-interference between the two races, where the Olympian Eternals would act as the gods' heralds on Earth at certain times. The pact was sealed and Azura changed her name to Thena to honor the pact. ====Arachne==== Her brother Ares told Athena of a mortal woman, Arachne, who claimed to be a better weaver then her. This caused Athena to bring Arachne to Ares for judgement over daring to make herself appear better than the gods, and appeared to have been executed for this. Unbeknownst to the Olympians, Arachne was secretly a herald of the trickster god Anansi, and desiring justice for her ignited a war between them and the African gods. Once the war subsided, Athena felt guilt for what happened to Arachne and resurrected her into the form of a creature with a spider body instead of legs. ====Tiresias==== Tiresias once stumbled upon Athena while she was bathing. As a result, the goddess decided to blind him. His mother begged Athena to lift the curse, but she refused to. Instead, she opened Tiresias' ears so he might hear all the whispers of the Gods. This two curses/gifts gave him a greater perspective of the world. ====Hercules==== As the Fates had prophesized that no god could slay the giants, but a mortal bearing the lion's sign, Athena convinced Zeus to conceive such a creature, Hercules, which would give them the upper hand in the coming Gigantomachy. Centuries ago Athena used foresight to predict the birth of Amadeus Cho and the events of the World War Hulk, predicting that while the still young Hercules would grow to be a force for good, Amadeus would always be her champion, foretelling the modern times and his final choosing in becoming a force for good himself, and her and Hercules's helper. ====Kyknos==== In 1268 BC, Hercules clashed with Ares' son Kyknos. Athena and Ares asked the Fates if Hercules would best him. They replied that Hercules would slay Kyknos unless he were killed first. Ares intervened on the battle to assist his son, but Athena came to Hercules' aid in order to level the playing field. Ultimately, Hercules succeeded in slaying Kyknos. ====Trojan War==== Athena also participated in the Trojan War taking the side of the Greeks against the Trojans to avenge, at least in her mind, an insult performed on her by the Trojan prince Paris. Paris had deemed Venus as the most beautiful goddess of all after a contest was formed among Venus, Athena and Hera to be judged as "the most beautiful". During the war, Athena fought against Ares, and empowered Diomedes so that he could strike Ares a near-mortal wound. ====Odyssey==== Odysseus whom she aided in returning home to Ithaca from the Trojan War and reclaiming his kingdom. ===Roman Empire=== In 146 B.C., the Romans conquered Macedonia and then Greece. They even adopted Olympian Gods, changing many of their names in the process. Athena became "Minerva". ===20th Century=

The pact was sealed and Azura changed her name to Thena to honor the pact. ====Arachne==== Her brother Ares told Athena of a mortal woman, Arachne, who claimed to be a better weaver then her. This caused Athena to bring Arachne to Ares for judgement over daring to make herself appear better than the gods, and appeared to have been executed for this. Unbeknownst to the Olympians, Arachne was secretly a herald of the trickster god Anansi, and desiring justice for her ignited a war between them and the African gods. Once the war subsided, Athena felt guilt for what happened to Arachne and resurrected her into the form of a creature with a spider body instead of legs. ====Tiresias==== Tiresias once stumbled upon Athena while she was bathing. As a result, the goddess decided to blind him. His mother begged Athena to lift the curse, but she refused to. Instead, she opened Tiresias' ears so he might hear all the whispers of the Gods. This two curses/gifts gave him a greater perspective of the world. ====Hercules==== As the Fates had prophesized that no god could slay the giants, but a mortal bearing the lion's sign, Athena convinced Zeus to conceive such a creature, Hercules, which would give them the upper hand in the coming Gigantomachy. Centuries ago Athena used foresight to predict the birth of Amadeus Cho and the events of the World War Hulk, predicting that while the still young Hercules would grow to be a force for good, Amadeus would always be her champion, foretelling the modern times and his final choosing in becoming a force for good himself, and her and Hercules's helper. ====Kyknos==== In 1268 BC, Hercules clashed with Ares' son Kyknos. Athena and Ares asked the Fates if Hercules would best him. They replied that Hercules would slay Kyknos unless he were killed first. Ares intervened on the battle to assist his son, but Athena came to Hercules' aid in order to level the playing field. Ultimately, Hercules succeeded in slaying Kyknos. ====Trojan War==== Athena also participated in the Trojan War taking the side of the Greeks against the Trojans to avenge, at least in her mind, an insult performed on her by the Trojan prince Paris. Paris had deemed Venus as the most beautiful goddess of all after a contest was formed among Venus, Athena and Hera to be judged as "the most beautiful". During the war, Athena fought against Ares, and empowered Diomedes so that he could strike Ares a near-mortal wound. ====Odyssey==== Odysseus whom she aided in returning home to Ithaca from the Trojan War and reclaiming his kingdom. ===Roman Empire=== In 146 B.C., the Romans conquered Macedonia and then Greece. They even adopted Olympian Gods, changing many of their names in the process. Athena became "Minerva". ===20th Century=
transportation: Dimensional teleportation using her own powers.
fields.trivia: Athena believes intelligence is essentially "pattern recognition." Although in the actual mythology Athena was not an oracular goddess making her precognitive abilities making no sense, she was once worshipped in Delphi as Athena Pronoia which means foresight.

palmer addley.name: Palmer Addley
palmer addley.origin: ===Origin=== Dr. Palmer Addley was a brilliant researcher D.A.R.P.A., until he committed suicide which he filmed. He was pronounced dead leaving only a mystery of why he did it. ===Palmer Addley is Dead=== A few months later all of Dr. Addley's projects started shutting down mysteriously. Dr. Addley's offensive weaponry projects began falling in the hands of the wrong people and attack occurred across the globe leaving the message "Palmer Addley is dead". The government investigated and Dr. Addley was proven to still be dead. ===Iron Man=== James Rhodes now going by Iron Man was sent on missions on behalf the US government. He was sent to investigate the attack. He followed a lead to Russia were he walked into a trap his armor was crippled by a virus and he was then hit with a nuclear weapon. After getting a new armor he discovered that Dr. Addley had developed a Nano Tech virus that he transferred his consciousness into. Having infected himself with this virus, he killed himself so that his organs would be distributed to needy people, thereby infecting them with his virus. Those infected with Dr. Addley's virus would soon unwittingly start developing his weaponry and sending it out into the world.

Wire and Doom inadvertently found Paloma while lost in cyberspace, and reactivated her. Paloma took control of the Pixel Corp and became an ally of Doom, diverting Pixel's material wealth to his cause while declaring cyberspace her domain. pamela douglas.name: Pamela Douglas
pamela douglas.origin: Pamela Douglas was an editor for a business trade journal called The Manhattan Project. She lived a normal life until she started feeling a presence in her head. In fact, it was her estranged cousin Heather (Moondragon), who had lost her physical body and had sought refuge in her closest living relative, Pamela. After a while, Heather was finally able to establish contact and told her cousin everything, requesting her help to get to Titan, where the supercomputer ISAAC has started creating a cloned body for her mind to inhabit. 150px|thumb|left|Shaved Hair Pamela was then attacked by two giant hands, which they came to learn belonged to the disembodied soul of Isaac Christians. Known as the Gargoyle, Isaac had been one of Moondragon's teammates on the Defenders, who had seemingly lost his life when she was corrupted by the Dragon of the Moon. They were able to calm down Isaac Christians' soul and make amends. Then, Pamela took the crystal that contained Isaac's soul to keep it safe close to her. Taveling in Moondragon's old ship, they made their way to Titan, where the locals made Pamela feel welcome, while they waited for Moondragon's clone to reach gestation. During this time, Pamela began to fall in love with a Titan named Demeityr. When gestation day arrived, Moondragon and Pamela discovered that once the baby clone was imprinted with Moondragon's soul, the baby would be given to the care of the Priests of Shao-Lom and Pamela would be returned to Earth. Both Pamela and Moondragon violently objected to these terms. At first, it looked as if they would have to give in to the powerful Titan leader Mentor, but Isaac Christians' soul spoke up and asked Mentor to remand the two women into his care. Mentor had come to know and respect Isaac Christians, so he agreed. Pamela, the cloned infant of Moondragon, and the soul of Isaac Christians then started on a tour of the galaxy in Moondragon's spaceship. Just after leaving Titan, their spaceship was pulled into a giant ship belonging to the mysterious Dance. Moondragon told Pamela that the powerful race moved through the universe and performed a variety of seemingly random acts. No one knew why. 150px|thumb|right|With Baby Heather The Dance members started forcing Pamela and the others into a column of fusion-level plasma. Somehow, Pamela and Moondragon's mental powers awakened and saved them from death. Not only did they teleport themselves out of the plasma column, but they also teleported Demeityr to the Dance ship. The Dance then let them go free, apparently done with them. Demeityr joined their little tour and they left for parts unknown. As the months went by, Moondragon's cloned body matured at an accelerated rate, but not fast enough to suit her. An encounter with the living nebulae, Cloud, who had also been a Defender, angered the arrogant Moondragon. A few days later, Moondragon became angered by the intimacy Pamela and Demeityr shared. She mentally assaulted them and began projecting her image as her adult self. 150px|thumb|left|Becoming Sundragon Moondragon then attacked Demeityr, Pamela, and Isaac, and teleported them outside to die in the vacuum of space. Luckily, a nearby star held part of the consciousness of the living nebulae, Cloud. Cloud saved them and then used her powers to activate the rest of Pamela's dormant powers, and to give her a new form. She also formed a body out of stellar matter for Isaac's soul to inhabit. She then created a dragon out of stellar mass, that Pamela could control and use as a form of travel. They then confronted Moondragon, who confessed that she felt as if no one really cared for her, and that everyone loved Pamela. Pamela and the others forgave Moondragon and told her that they loved her. Touched by their love, Moondragon realized the error of her ways and promised not to make the same mistakes again. Pamela, now calling herself Sundragon, Demeityr, and Isaac resumed their exploration of space while Moondragon headed back for Earth.

pamela grayson.name: Pamela Grayson
pamela grayson.origin: Pamela Grayson was the best friend of Judy Laughton, an employee at the secret prison where the Absorbing Man was being held. Shortly after Judy apparently committed suicide by throwing herself in front of a subway train, Pamela met Bruce Banner, who had spoken to Judy moments before her death. As they discussed the tragedy, Pamela was unknowingly targeted by the Absorbing Man's newly developed psychic abilities, which allowed him to possess her mind intermittently. Under his influence she attacked muggers, struck Banner, and later attempted to push him in front of a subway train, though she remembered none of these incidents afterward. After Banner saved her life, the two realized that Judy's death and Pamela's blackouts were connected to Carl Creel's imprisonment. Pamela recognized Creel from television after experiencing disturbing visions while under his influence, leading her and Banner to conclude that the villain was mentally controlling people from inside his prison. While searching Judy's apartment for answers, Pamela discovered confidential information that allowed her to contact Dr. David Zhan, although Warden Johnson prevented the warning from reaching him. When Creel began controlling a young girl to force Banner into helping him escape, Pamela followed Banner to New Jersey aboard a train bound for the town hiding the secret prison. Determined to avenge Judy's death and stop Creel, she refused to abandon Banner despite the danger and remained by his side as they tracked the source of the psychic attacks. After Banner infiltrated the prison under Creel's coercion, Pamela helped rescue the possessed child and reached the underground complex during the ensuing battle between the Hulk and the Absorbing Man. There she learned of Dr. Zhan's dying clue and realized that Creel's psychic power required a living mind to inhabit. Using Zhan's corpse as bait, Pamela deceived the Absorbing Man into abandoning his own body in order to search the dead scientist's mind for information. Trapped within a lifeless brain, Creel found himself unable to escape as his physical body dissolved, apparently defeating him. With the crisis over, Pamela bid farewell to Bruce Banner before he disappeared once again into anonymity.

pamela hawley.name: Pamela Hawley
pamela hawley.origin: Lady Pamela Hawley was Nick Fury's girlfriend when he was stationed in England during WWII. They met during a German air raid and fell in love. Her father was the nobleman Lord Hawley. In 1943, Pamela, Nick and "Dum Dum" Dugan encountered an amnesiac woman who was wandering aimlessly in London. When the woman called Pamela by name, they decided to take care of her until they could get her some help. The three of them were soon approached in a pub by a man who introduced himself as Dr. Stephen Strange. Secretly Earth's Sorcerer Supreme from decades in the future, Strange revealed that the woman was his friend, Morgana Blessing, and claimed that she was suffering from partial amnesia due to several serious psychic traumas that she had experienced in recent days. Without revealing that he and Morgana were both from the future, Strange left Morgana in Pamela's care while he made preparations to restore her memory. That night, Morgana was kidnapped from Hawley Manor by Sir Anthony Baskerville who needed her as part of a ritual to incarnate Dormammu on Earth. Fearing that Pamela might have seen his face, Baskerville kidnapped her as well. The scheme by Baskerville and his allies was ultimately thwarted, and Doctor Strange used his magic to cause Pamela, Nick and Dum Dum to forget what had happened. Later that year, Pamela wrote a Christmas card and sent it to Nick. However, the envelope containing the card was lost behind a file cabinet in a British post office. Sometime later, Lady Pamela Hawley died during another German bombing raid in London before Fury, who had bought an engagement ring, had a chance to propose to her. Decades later, when the post office was razed, the long-lost envelope was found and sent to Colonel Nick Fury in the United States who received it just before Christmas. Pamela was reportedly reincarnated into the identity of Morgana Blessing.
abilities: Pamela was a skilled medic, experienced in providing first aid to people injured in air raids.

fields.notes: There is conflicting in-story evidence as to exactly when Pamela Hawley's relationship with Nick Fury occurred. On the one hand, depicts Pamela and Nick as being a couple in the year 1943, and showed Nick (in the present-day of 1993) receiving a long-lost Christmas card from Pamela that had been mailed back in 1943. On the other hand, showed Pamela and Nick together on a date soon after he had returned from Okinawa, Japan, where he and the Howling Commandos had rescued a captured Allied spy just before the Battle of Okinawa began, an event that occurred in the real world on April 1st, 1945. Additionally, the captured spy was Colonel Phil "Pillbox" Parker, someone with whom Fury had served during the Battle of the Bulge, which in the real world had been fought from December 16th, 1944, to January 28th, 1945. If the "Okinawa" and "Battle of the Bulge" references in that Sgt. Fury issue are correct, then Pamela's death in could not have occurred any earlier than mid-April of 1945. And if the "1943" references are also correct, then that would mean that their relationship began sometime in 1943 and lasted a minimum of 16 months before ending when she died. Although Pamela's father did testify that he had known Nick Fury for "many months" in , there's really no other in-story evidence that they had been a couple for anywhere near that long a time. The only other explanation is that some of the dates are wrong. Either Pamela met Nick in 1943 and died sometime in 1944, or she died in 1945 and didn't meet Nick until sometime in 1944. The fact shows that "Junior" Juniper, who died in the same issue in which Pamela was introduced, was part of a mission to rescue a captured French Resistance leader who knew the time and place of D-Day does suggest that Pamela must have met Nick sometime after early 1944. Having said that, it should be noted that the continuity between the Sgt. Fury series and the real WWII timeline has been described as being "all over the place." When Doctor Strange first met Pamela Hawley, he speculated that she and Morgan Blessing, who slightly resembled each other, might have been "astral twins." However, Strange later discovered that Pamela and Morgana were actually different incarnations of the same soul, one that had already lived hundreds upon hundreds of lives over the course of millennia.
fields.trivia: Pamela held the title of "Lady", which is a formal title in the United Kingdom. The women entitled to use it include women with titles of nobility or honorary titles suo jure (in her own right), female members of the Order of the Garter and the Order of the Thistle, the wives of lords, baronets, Scottish feudal barons, lairds, or knights, and the daughters of dukes, marquesses, and earls. Widows and former wives of knights retain their married style until their death or until their marriage to someone else.

pamela kramer.name: Pamela Kramer
pamela kramer.origin: Pamela "Pam" Kramer was the daughter of Michael Kramer, a former pilot of an all-black American air force fighter squadron in World War II who, in 1944, had been captured in Germany and subjected to genetic alterations to make him host of, while immune to, a genocidal biological weapon called the Judas Plague. Michael, codenamed the Judas Man, was rescued and the laboratory was destroyed. As the Judas Plague required a catalyst to activate it, which was believed destroyed in the lab, Michael felt he could have a normal life and hid his past. When Michael had a daughter, the genetic changes were inherited and her body came to have the antidote to the Judas plague, even though they were unaware of it. Living on the West Coast, Pamela grew up loving her father and, when she was old enough, she enrolled in law school at the University of California, Berkeley, with one of her professors being Adam Ishima. During Pamela's first year of college, Michael began to be harassed by thugs sent by the nihilistic villain Viper, who wanted to get Michael to spread the plague through the United States of America. Viper had obtained the catalyst that would allow him to activate the plague, and had also discovered that Pamela had the cure for the plague, so he decided to kidnap Pamela as well. After months of chasing, Michael became frightened, and Pamela saw his behavior and attitude change; despite this, Michael did not tell Pamela the reason why he was being persecuted. Eventually, Michael abandoned Pamela to try to escape the country by boat. Pamela called the SFPD for help, but they paid no attention to her, at least not to her satisfaction. Wanting to hire a private investigator, Pamela listened to the recommendation of her professor Adam Ishima and decided to present her case to researcher Jessica Drew, who had helped Ishima's brother shortly before with good results for a reasonable price, something that Pamela appreciated because she didn't have too much money. When Pamela went to Drew's office in the Hunter-Dulin Building in San Francisco after class, she was openly accosted by three Viper agents (Deke, Freddie and Gino) in an aircar and armed with high-tech weapons, who attempted to abduct her on the spot; Viper, eager to capture Pamela, would have gone in person but did not want it to be known that she was still alive. Although Pamela was outnumbered and forced into the aircar, she resisted long enough to attract the attention of the superheroine Spider-Woman (secretly Jessica Drew), who came to the rescue, leaving Gino behind in the building. When the other two thugs hinted that they were also interested in Pamela's father, she got a second wind, determined to confront the people who had threatened him even if it put her own life in danger, and damaged the delicate mechanisms of the aircar, causing the vehicle to crash into the ground on California Street. With two of the thugs stunned, Spider-Woman helped Pamela recover, claiming to be an associate of Drew's. SFPD Detective Sabrina Morrel showed up to arrest Deke and Freddie and take witness statements, Viper and her second Silver Samurai flew by in a second aircar to activate an explosive grafted to their hitmen and kill them (but Gino, being too far away, was unaffected). Spider-Woman pursued Viper and the Samurai, but failed to apprehend them. Morrel then took Pamela's statement at the Hall of Justice, and when she was done, Pamela talked to Drew about officially hiring her. Pamela was unhappy with the police, who had so far done nothing about her case, and even then she felt that her father was being treated like a criminal. Drew accepted Pamela's case, but seeing that Pamela was in danger of being attacked by Viper again, Drew decided to send her to Drew's personal residence at 1 Yarbro Court, to better protect her with the help of Drew's roommate, actress Lindsay McCabe - who was sleeping when they arrived. McCabe agreed to stay home with Pamela, asking Pamela to help her rehearse, and they set up a prearranged signal for phone calls and contacts (Pamela, not being used to such situations, mistakenly picked up the phone on one occasion, but McCabe promptly hung up on her). Somehow, however, Viper's forces discovered that Pamela had hired Drew and was hiding out at Drew's home. By this time, sorceress Morgan Le Fay had manipulated Viper into believing that she, Viper, was Jessica Drew's long-lost mother, but despite her emotional dismay, Viper went ahead with the plan and attempted to capture Pamela while sending Silver Samurai to get her. Michael; the plan was that the Samurai tailed Drew so that Drew would find Michael for them.
